Conclusion: 该调度级复用机制在不改变训练语义的前提下，显著提升长上下文RL post-training的计算效率和显存利用率，且可无缝集成现有并行策略，是一个实用且高效的训练加速方案。

Abstract: GRPO- and PPO-style LLM post-training commonly sample multiple trajectories from the same prompt and then train on the resulting group. In long-context RL workloads, this shared prompt-side prefix can contain retrieved passages, visual tokens, tool schemas, system instructions, or task context, while the full rollout group is still too large to pack into one training microbatch. Standard dense trainers therefore recompute the same prefix forward and backward for every trajectory. We present a schedule-level reuse mechanism that decouples prefix and suffix computation. The schedule runs prefix forward once, executes suffixes as ordinary microbatches while reading prefix K/V and accumulating prefix-side gK/gV , and then runs prefix backward once on the accumulated gradient cache. This reordered schedule is equivalent to baseline training over real arithmetic and aligns numerically within finite-precision tolerance. Because only K/V and gK/gV are hot during suffix computation, the approach offloads dormant prefix activations, integrates with TP/EP/CP/PP and DP-style placement at the execution level, and preserves aux-loss-based MoE router semantics through logical prefix-token accounting. On dense Llama3-8B, Qwen3-8B, and MoE Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B configurations, the schedule matches optimizer updates across TP/CP/PP/EP combinations, aligns on a 100-step real RL trace replay, reaches up to 4.395x speedup (2.930x under a conservative compile-on comparison) as prefix ratio and rollout group size grow, and reduces Phase-B peak HBM by up to 59.1%, extending the Llama3-8B capacity frontier from 17,920 to 29,696 total tokens.

</details>


### [298] [AcOrch: Accelerating Sampling-based GNN Training under CPU-NPU Heterogeneous Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01161)
*Kefu Chen,Xin Ai,Qiange Wang,Yanfeng Zhang,Ge Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AcOrch是一个针对CPU-NPU异构平台优化的采样型GNN训练系统，通过细粒度任务编排和两级流水线执行模型，在Ascend 910B处理器上实现了相比MindSporeGL平均2.31倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样型GNN训练包含子图采样、特征收集和模型训练等多阶段任务，不同阶段对CPU和NPU等异构计算资源的需求差异大，现有系统未能充分利用这些资源，导致资源利用率低。

Method: 提出AcOrch系统，采用两级流水线执行模型：第一级在CPU与NPU之间实现采样、收集和训练的流水线重叠；第二级在NPU内部AIC（AI Cube）单元和AIV（AI Vector）单元之间实现计算重叠。通过分析NPU异构计算特征，将任务合理映射到不同计算单元。

Result: 在Ascend 910B AI处理器上的实验表明，AcOrch相比当前最先进的NPU原生图学习系统MindSporeGL实现了平均2.31倍的加速。

Conclusion: AcOrch有效解决了异构平台上采样型GNN训练的资源协调问题，通过两级流水线和细粒度任务编排充分提升了CPU和NPU资源利用率。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success in various applications. Sampling-based GNN training, which conducts mini-batch training on sampled subgraphs, has become a promising solution for large-scale graphs. Given the resource-intensive nature of sampling-based GNN training, Neural Processing Units (NPUs), such as the Ascend AI processor, offer a promising alternative due to their high throughput and energy efficiency, making them well-suited for GNN workloads. However, the multi-stage nature of sampling-based training, which involves subgraph sampling, feature gathering, and model training, with different resource requirements and computation volume. This requires careful coordination to fully utilize the heterogeneous computation resources of CPUs and NPUs. In this work, we present AcOrch, a sampling-based GNN training system optimized for CPU-NPU heterogeneous platforms. AcOrch offers fine-grained task orchestration and adopts a two-level pipelined execution model to overlap sampling, gathering, and training. It analyzes the heterogeneous compute features of NPUs and maps tasks to AI Cube (AIC) units, AI Vector (AIV) units, and CPU cores accordingly. Moreover, the two-level pipeline enables overlapping execution not only between the CPU and NPU, but also among different types of compute units within the NPU (e.g., AIC and AIV units), thereby maximizing the utilization of available resources. Experiments on an Ascend 910B AI processor show that AcOrch achieves an average speedup of 2.31x over the state-of-the-art NPU-native graph learning system, MindSporeGL.

</details>


### [299] [The World's Fastest Matching Engine Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01183)
*Jake Yoon*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出两种数据结构优化——优先级指示节点(PIN)和邻域感知的插入/删除操作，消除了传统订单簿中指针追踪和根到叶搜索的成本，在单核上实现每秒3200万条订单消息、亚微秒级尾部延迟，比现有开源引擎快5-11倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子交易所的订单簿存储层决定了撮合延迟，传统实现（平衡树+链表）在微爆发条件下产生尾部延迟尖峰，损害市场质量。需要消除指针追踪遍历和根到叶搜索这两项核心开销。

Method: 提出两种数据结构：(1) 优先级指示节点(PIN)——条目占据固定容量、连续可寻址的槽位，每个槽位携带全局优先级指示器，O(1)更新，无需比较即可直接解析插入位置；(2) 邻域感知插入/删除——在已知键的中序邻居时，通过O(1)引用写入附加/移除节点，再单路径重平衡，统一支持红黑树、AVL树和B/B+树。

Result: 单核CPU在数百万条/秒的微爆发条件下，每秒处理3200万条订单消息，尾部延迟亚微秒级；比现有最佳开源匹配引擎快5-11倍。单96核实例在10000个交易符号上每秒处理6.4亿条消息。

Conclusion: 通过消除订单簿中的指针追踪和搜索开销，大幅提升撮合引擎的性能和延迟稳定性，有效应对微爆发场景。

Abstract: Every electronic exchange relies on an order book whose storage layer determines matching latency. The dominant implementation -- linked lists chained through a balanced tree -- imposes two costs on every operation: pointer-chased traversal to reach the insertion point, and root-to-leaf search to locate the target price level. Under micro-burst conditions these costs produce tail-latency spikes that degrade market quality when liquidity is most needed. We present two data-structure contributions that eliminate these costs. The first is the Priority-Indicated Node (PIN), a priority queue in which entries occupy fixed-capacity, contiguously addressable slots, each carrying a per-slot indicator encoding the entry's global priority. Unlike heaps, which require O(log n) comparisons per operation, the PIN resolves insertion position directly from the indicators without comparing entries; indicator updates are O(1), independent of queue size. The second addresses a broader inefficiency: balanced search trees search root-to-leaf on every insertion and deletion, even when the caller already knows the key's in-order neighbors -- as in ordered event streams, incremental index already knows the key's in-order neighbors -- as in ordered event streams, incremental index maintenance, and electronic trading. Neighbor-aware insertion and deletion exploit known neighbor references to attach or remove a node with O(1) reference writes, followed by single-path rebalancing, uniformly across red-black, AVL, and B/B+-tree variants. A single CPU core sustains 32 million order messages per second with sub-microsecond tail latency under multi-million message-per-second micro-bursts, and is 5-11x faster than the best available open-source matching engines on the same hardware. Scaled to a single 96-core instance, the engine sustains 640 million messages per second across 10,000 symbols.

</details>


### [300] [Fail-Closed Lowering of Resident KV Claims onto LLM Serving Runtimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01387)
*Lukas Stepanek*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文论证了当前LLM推理系统中的KV-cache原语（如优先级、TTL、卸载、事件、调度、路由）比未来重用承诺（ResidentClaim）更弱，并提出了一套形式化的降级（lowering）关系、检查器、描述符格式及不良降级套件，用于分类运行时/映射模式是否符合ResidentClaim。通过TensorRT-LLM、SGLang/HiCache、Dynamo和vLLM的实证分析，验证了语义边界，而非性能或兼容性调查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM服务运行时的KV-cache原语（如保留优先级、TTL、卸载、事件、无驱逐调度、KV感知路由）虽然表面上类似未来重用控制机制，但实际并未承担未来重用承诺的责任。需要严格定义并验证哪些运行时行为可以被视为满足ResidentClaim（关于未来KV重用的承诺），以建立清晰的语义边界。

Method: 1) 定义ResidentClaim降级（lowering）的形式化条件：必须绑定行为到索赔身份、物化谓词、有序生命周期事件和索赔作用域结果。2) 提出fail-closed降级关系、验证检查器、描述符格式和不良降级套件。3) 将运行时/映射模式分类为：原生符合、适配器观测证据、适配器策略证据（受控压力下）、近似基板、被拒绝映射、未知证据。4) 在TensorRT-LLM、SGLang/HiCache、Dynamo和vLLM上进行实证分析。

Result: 1) TensorRT-LLM、SGLang/HiCache和Dynamo表现出强基板和选定的适配器阳性证据，但未实现原生ResidentClaim符合。2) vLLM的本地补丁连接器/调度器边界机制实现了正向系统证据：索赔元数据流经真实进程内卸载/加载行为，受控的同索赔恢复失败到达vLLM的无效KV加载路径，成为有序的索赔作用域fail-closed结果。

Conclusion: 研究建立了一个校准的语义边界，而非生产性能声明或兼容性调查。当前主流LLM推理系统（TensorRT-LLM、SGLang/HiCache、Dynamo）未原生支持ResidentClaim，但通过形式化框架可以分类和验证不同级别的符合性。vLLM的补丁方案展示了可行的正向证据路径。

Abstract: LLM serving runtimes increasingly expose KV-cache primitives that resemble future-reuse controls: retention priority, TTL-like duration, host or storage offload, block events, active no-evict scheduling, and KV-aware routing. This paper argues that such primitives are weaker than accepted future-KV obligations. A runtime can expose priority, offload, events, and routing without accepting responsibility for a future reuse claim. We study ResidentClaim lowering: when a runtime primitive, trusted adapter, or patch can be treated as satisfying an accepted claim about future KV reuse. A conformant lowering must bind behavior to accepted claim identity, a materialization predicate, ordered lifecycle events, and claim-scoped outcomes. We contribute a fail-closed lowering relation, checker, descriptor format, and bad-lowering suite that classify runtime/mode mappings as native conformance, adapter-observational evidence, adapter-policy evidence under controlled pressure, approximation substrate, rejected mapping, or unknown evidence. The checker validates manually curated, anchored runtime descriptors against obligation bundles; it does not prove that unaudited runtime behavior is complete. Public TensorRT-LLM, SGLang/HiCache, and Dynamo expose strong substrates and selected adapter positives, but not native ResidentClaim conformance. The positive systems witness is a local patched vLLM connector/scheduler-boundary mechanism: claim metadata flows through real in-process offload/load behavior, and controlled same-claim restoration failure reaches vLLM's invalid-KV-load path and becomes an ordered claim-scoped fail-closed outcome. The result is a calibrated semantics boundary, not a production performance claim or a compatibility survey.

</details>


### [301] [Hierarchical Online Prompt Mutation with Dual-Loop Feedback for Guardrailed Evidence Document Generation: A Production-Evaluation Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01472)
*Nataraj Agaram Sundar Tejas Morabia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出HOPM框架，一种分层在线提示突变方法，在生产级纠纷证据工作流中通过路由选择、确定性护栏和双反馈（人工+自动评判）优化提示策略，相比静态提示将胜率从34.7%提升至45.7%，平均Likert质量从3.18提升至4.40，问题标记率从15.3%降至5.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险生产文档生成系统需要语言模型具备适应性、基于证据和可审计性，现有静态提示方法无法满足这些需求，因此需要一种能在线动态优化提示的策略框架。

Method: HOPM采用层次化在线提示突变框架：家族/版本路由器选择提示，确定性护栏将失败归因于可突变的提示令牌类别，双反馈（人工审核+自动评判）同时更新路由和突变优先级。通过7种变体在600个案例上进行比较消融实验，涵盖静态提示、手动迭代、仅bandit路由、仅突变适应、仅人工反馈、仅自动评判反馈和完整HOPM。

Result: 完整HOPM将胜率从34.7%提升至45.7%（+11.0pp），金额加权胜率从22.3%提升至41.4%（+19.1pp），平均Likert质量从3.18提升至4.40，问题标记率从15.3%降至5.2%。所有改进均具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: HOPM框架有效提升了生产级文档生成系统的性能，双反馈循环和层次化提示突变机制优于静态提示及其他消融变体。论文提供了完整的可复现评估结构，包括控制设置、样本量、置信区间、配对检验等。

Abstract: High-stakes production document-generation systems require language models to be adaptive, evidence-grounded, and auditable. We present HOPM, a hierarchical online prompt mutation framework evaluated on a real marketplace dispute-evidence workflow. HOPM treats prompts as online policies: a family/version router selects a prompt, deterministic guardrails attribute failures to mutable prompt-token categories, and dual feedback from human review and an automated judge updates both routing and mutation priorities. The primary evidence is an observed matched production-evaluation ablation: seven variants are evaluated on the same 600 cases each, enabling component comparisons against static prompting, manual iteration, bandit-only routing, mutation-only adaptation, human-only feedback, auto-judge-only feedback, and full dual-loop HOPM. Full HOPM improves count win rate over a static control from 34.7% to 45.7% (+11.0 pp; paired McNemar p = 1.31e-11) and amount-weighted win rate from 22.3% to 41.4% (+19.1 pp; 95% paired bootstrap CI [10.3, 28.9] pp). It also increases mean Likert quality from 3.18 to 4.40 and reduces issue-flag rate from 15.3% to 5.2%. Supporting review artifacts cover 770 generated-text reviews, 318 labeled reviewer exports, a 10-case/61-rating calibration slice, and a 70-case/350-rating OCR benchmark; these artifacts calibrate rubric, guardrail, title-risk, and OCR-risk interpretation rather than substituting for the production ablation. The paper includes control setup, sample sizes, confidence intervals, paired tests, prompt-token categories, pseudocode, schema, rubric, guardrail taxonomy, and a constructed example so the evaluation structure can be reproduced without exposing proprietary evidence.

</details>


### [302] [Move the Query, Not the Cache: Characterizing Cross-Instance Latent Attention Redistribution Across GPU Fabrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01502)
*Bole Ma,Jan Eitzinger,Harald Köstler,Gerhard Wellein*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了在跨实例部署场景下，多头潜在注意力（MLA）机制中路由查询与搬运缓存两种策略的权衡，提出了一个拓扑感知的成本模型和闭式决策谓词，并在真实多节点H100集群上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM的稀疏注意力索引器以块为单位选择KV缓存，而智能体工作负载中多个子智能体查询同一大型代码库时频繁重用这些块。当语料超出单GPU容量需跨实例分区时，查询与所选块常位于不同GPU上，导致跨实例注意力需求。现有系统采用搬运缓存策略，但MLA通过将每个token的键和值压缩为窄向量，使路由查询的成本低于搬运缓存，因此需要系统性地比较两种策略的优劣。

Method: 在真实多节点H100集群上对跨实例MLA注意力进行特征化，提炼出拓扑感知的成本模型（探测/传输/计算/返回/合并五个阶段）和闭式路由/搬运/本地决策谓词。在IBGDA（InfiniBand全局直接内存访问）上测量模型常数，验证批处理往返时间预测精度在~7%以内。

Result: 在解码阶段，路由查询策略将搬运缓存的代价（连续块约3ms的重新适配拼接，或选择下的分散收集）替换为数十微秒的往返时间，并通过探测延迟而非峰值带宽选择网络结构。成本模型在IBGDA上跟踪批处理往返时间误差约7%。

Conclusion: 该成本模型和谓词不限于MLA，可推广到任何通过压缩或稀疏选择将注意力缩小为小块的工作（如DeepSeek-V3.2、V4、GLM-5.1）。扩展到新架构仅需测量两个系数：路由负载和搬运缓存的成本。

Abstract: Frontier LLMs increasingly decide what a query attends to with a sparse-attention indexer that picks a few KV-cache blocks per query: attention's unit is now a small, reusable chunk. Agentic workloads hammer it: many sub-agents query one large codebase, reusing the same blocks. When that corpus outgrows one GPU it is partitioned across instances, so a query and the blocks it selects often sit on different GPUs: answering it means attention across instances. The reflex of prior cross-instance KV systems is to move the cache: pull the selected blocks to the requester. Multi-head Latent Attention inverts the arithmetic, compressing each token's key and value into one narrow vector, so a routed query row is only ~1 KB, smaller than the chunk it attends; routing the query is then often cheaper than moving the cache. Which primitive wins, over which fabric and request shape, is uncharted, least of all on device-initiated RDMA that makes per-request cross-node transfers cheap. We characterize cross-instance MLA attention on a real multi-node H100 cluster, distilling two reusable artifacts: a topology-aware cost model (probe / transfer / compute / return / merge) and a closed-form route/fetch/local predicate, whose constants we measure on real IBGDA, where the model tracks batched round-trips to within ~7%. At decode it routes the query, trading the cost of moving the cache (a ~3 ms re-adaptation splice for a contiguous chunk, or a scattered gather under selection) for a tens-of-microsecond round trip, and picks the fabric by probe latency, not peak bandwidth. We instantiate the cost model and predicate for MLA, but neither is MLA-specific: they apply wherever compression or sparse selection shrinks attention to small chunks (DeepSeek-V3.2, V4, and GLM-5.1 today). Extending them to a new architecture requires measuring just two coefficients: the routed payload and fetch's move-the-cache cost.

</details>


### [303] [Compliance-Scored Best-of-N Guardrail Orchestration for Multimodal Document Generation in Payments Dispute Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01513)
*Nataraj Agaram Sundar,Tejas Morabia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向高风险企业文档生成的护栏编排层，通过多候选生成与显式合规评分实现早期退出，在支付争议防御摘要场景中取得了+11.0%的胜率提升（p<0.001），并在20秒内完成5次尝试，合规率达91%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险企业文档生成（如金融争议叙述、合规通知、审计摘要）中，生产系统通常将PII脱敏、内容审核、格式验证等步骤拼凑在一起，导致逻辑碎片化、请求路径缓慢和运营成本高昂，亟需统一的护栏层来保证模式正确性、策略合规性和低延迟大规模操作。

Method: 提出一个面向文本和图像输入的护栏编排层：耦合多候选生成与显式合规评分用于早期退出；运行可配置的并行生成头，根据加权护栏（包括PII检测、内容审核、模式约束和领域规则）对候选进行评分，返回最佳评分输出及选择元数据。

Result: 运营读出版本报告20秒内5次尝试，91%合规率；支付争议防御摘要场景中，变量组整体胜率301/659 vs 对照组536/1548，对应+11.0个百分点（95% CI [6.6, 15.5], p<0.001）；调整后的未收物品案件+7.5个百分点（95% CI [0.2, 15.7], p=0.045）；欺诈和地方证据排名增量方向积极但未达统计显著性；报告了770次生成证据评审和70例OCR切片的负责任AI证据质量信号。

Conclusion: 所提出的护栏编排层在合规性、延迟和业务胜率方面均取得积极效果，并通过请求接口、评分逻辑、伪代码和操作证据边界记录了可复现性边界。

Abstract: High-stakes enterprise document generation, including financial dispute narratives, compliance notices, and audit summaries, demands schema correctness, policy compliance, and low-latency operation at scale. Prior to a unified guardrail layer, production systems often stitched together separate PII redaction, content moderation, and format validation steps, leading to fragmented logic, slower request paths, and higher operational cost.
  We present a guardrail orchestration layer for text and image inputs that couples multi-candidate generation with an explicit compliance score used for early exit. The framework runs configurable parallel generation heads, scores candidates against weighted guardrails including PII detection, content moderation, schema constraints, and domain rules, and returns the best-scoring output with selection metadata. The available operational readout reports 5 attempts within 20 seconds and 91 percent compliance.
  For payments dispute defense summaries, we analyze aggregate operational scenario readouts rather than a randomized A/B test. Variable cohorts show higher count win rates than controls overall, 301/659 versus 536/1548, corresponding to +11.0 percentage points with 95 percent confidence interval [6.6, 15.5] and p < 0.001, and for adjusted item-not-received cases, +7.5 percentage points with 95 percent confidence interval [0.2, 15.7] and p = 0.045. Fraud and local evidence-ranking deltas are directionally positive but not statistically significant from the aggregate count data. We also report reviewer-calibrated Responsible-AI evidence-quality signals from 770 generated-evidence reviews and a 70-case OCR slice, and document the reproducibility boundary through the request interface, scoring logic, pseudocode, and operational evidence boundary.

</details>


### [304] [Self-Conditioned Positional HNSW for Overlap-Aware Retrieval in Chunked-Document RAG Systems: Method and Industrial Evidence-Quality Audit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01542)
*Nataraj Agaram Sundar,Tejas Morabia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中文档分块重叠导致的邻近重复证据浪费问题，提出轻量级SCP-HNSW方法，通过位置编码和两阶段查询机制实现重叠感知检索，并引入工业级人工审计验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准分块+重叠策略导致top-k检索频繁返回相邻重复块，浪费prompt预算且降低证据多样性；现有方法缺乏对重叠问题的显式处理及可审计的质量评估框架。

Method: 1) 在块嵌入后附加低维位置编码；2) 设计两阶段查询：先检索候选块，再用查询特定文档位置先验过滤；3) 引入最小索引间隔选择器保证最终上下文多样性。HNSW图结构本身无需修改。

Result: 文本审计770条中574条(74.5%)评分为3/5(满分5)，仅39条(5%)评1-2分；OCR审计中干净截图通过率95%，手写/模糊截图降至45%，评分一致性中等到强。

Conclusion: 重叠感知、可审计的RAG检索方法有效减少重复证据，工业审计揭示了当前方法在脏数据场景下的瓶颈，需进一步做控制消融实验以支持因果性结论。

Abstract: Chunked-document retrieval is a common component of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Documents are split into overlapping chunks, embedded, and indexed with approximate nearest-neighbor search such as hierarchical navigable small world graphs (HNSW). Overlap improves boundary coverage but induces a practical failure mode: top-k retrieval often returns near-adjacent chunks that repeat evidence and waste prompt budget. We propose Self-Conditioned Positional HNSW (SCP-HNSW), a lightweight modification that appends a low-dimensional positional code to chunk embeddings and uses a two-pass query procedure to estimate and apply a query-specific document-position prior. SCP-HNSW leaves HNSW graph construction and traversal unchanged while adding an auditable minimum-index-gap selector for final context construction. We also integrate industrial review artifacts for generated evidence quality: a 770-review text-evidence audit with 318 fully labeled reviews and a 70-case OCR audit with 350 ratings. The text audit shows that 574 of 770 projected reviews are rated 3/5, only 39 fall in the 1-2 range, and narrative reviewer detail appears much more often than structured issue flags. The OCR audit shows slice-level pass rates from 95% for clean chat screenshots to 45% for handwritten/blurry captures, with moderate to strong agreement. These results motivate overlap-aware, audit-friendly RAG retrieval and identify the remaining controlled retrieval ablations needed for causal performance claims.

</details>


### [305] [TwinQuant: Learnable Subspace Decomposition for 4-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01556)
*Haodong Wang,Junjie Liu,Zicong Hong,Qianli Liu,Jian Lin,Song Guo,Xu Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TwinQuant提出了一种面向大语言模型的4比特量化框架，通过学习可量化的分解子空间并联合优化低秩和残差分量，在保持接近FP16精度的同时实现最高1.8倍的端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4比特量化方法通过对权重矩阵进行分解（如SVD）分别量化低秩和残差分量，但这类分解针对的是残差的实值能量最小化，而非量化后的实际误差，导致精度损失严重。

Method: TwinQuant包含三个关键设计：(1) 在Stiefel流形和一般线性流形上联合优化，学习量化友好的分解子空间，分别对低秩和残差分量进行变换以平坦化分布并减小动态范围不平衡；(2) 融合双分量核，将两阶段低秩计算流水化在芯片上，通过单次epilogue合并两个分量，避免中间全局内存通信。

Result: 在LLaMA3和Qwen3模型上，TwinQuant保持接近FP16的精度，相比FP16基线实现最高1.8倍的端到端加速。

Conclusion: TwinQuant通过联合优化分解子空间和高效的融合核设计，有效解决了4比特量化中精度与效率的权衡问题，证明了量化友好的分解学习比传统实值能量最小化分解更适合低精度推理。

Abstract: 4-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and latency of large language model inference, but its aggressive precision reduction can severely degrade accuracy. Prior methods address this by decomposing each weight matrix into two components (e.g., via singular value decomposition) and quantizing them separately, assigning the bulk of values to a low-precision residual component while handling outliers with a high-precision low-rank component. However, such decompositions are designed to minimize the real-valued energy of the residual, rather than the post-quantization error of the residual and low-rank components. We propose TwinQuant, a 4-bit quantization framework that learns quantization-friendly decomposed subspaces and jointly reshapes both the low-rank and residual components. TwinQuant learns component-specific transformations via a joint optimization over the Stiefel and general linear manifolds, flattening their distributions and reducing dynamic-range imbalance. To enable efficient end-to-end execution, we further design a fused dual-component kernel that pipelines the two-stage low-rank computation on-chip and merges both components with a single epilogue, avoiding intermediate global-memory traffic. Across LLaMA3 and Qwen3 models, TwinQuant preserves near-FP16 accuracy and delivers up to $1.8\times$ end-to-end speedup over an FP16 baseline.

</details>


### [306] [Don't Let a Few Network Failures Slow the Entire AllReduce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01680)
*Peiqing Chen,Jiedong Jiang,Nengneng Yu,Yuefeng Wang,Sixian Xiong,Wei Wang,Zaoxing Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出首个非对称网络下AllReduce的信息论下界，并设计OptCC算法，在50%带宽损失下仅比无损NCCL慢2-6%，而现有方案高达57%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模GPU集群中网络故障频繁，现有容错方案（如NCCL通过故障NIC重路由）虽能保持训练不中断，但受损服务器在标准ring算法中成为拖慢整体通信的瓶颈，缺乏对非对称带宽下AllReduce理论极限的理解。

Method: 1. 首次推导非对称网络带宽下AllReduce完成时间的信息论下界；2. 证明当故障节点保留至少一半带宽时，相对无故障最优的额外开销仅为O(1/p)；3. 设计四阶段流水线AllReduce算法OptCC逼近该下界。

Result: 在SimAI模拟器上，OptCC在50%带宽损失的故障场景下，AllReduce完成时间仅比NCCL无故障环算法慢2-6%，而现有最优容错方案开销高达57%。

Conclusion: OptCC算法有效缩小了现有容错方案与理论下界之间的差距，在常见网络故障场景下几乎达到无故障性能，为大规模GPU集群的容错通信提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Network failures are among the most frequent hardware faults in large-scale GPU clusters and a leading cause of training-job interruptions. Modern collective communication libraries such as NCCL mitigate network failures by rerouting traffic through surviving NICs on the same server, trading reduced inter-node bandwidth for uninterrupted training. However, the degraded server remains on the critical path of the standard ring algorithm, slowing the entire collective. We present the first information-theoretic lower bound on AllReduce completion time under asymmetric network bandwidth and show that when the straggler retains at least half of its original bandwidth, the unavoidable overhead relative to the fault-free optimum is only O(1/p) for p GPUs. We then design OptCC, a four-stage pipelined AllReduce algorithm that approaches this lower bound. Experiments on SimAI confirm that OptCC closes the gap left by existing fault-tolerant schemes: under practical network failures with up to 50% bandwidth loss, OptCC completes AllReduce within 2-6% of NCCL's fault-free ring performance, whereas the state-of-the-art incurs up to 57% overhead.

</details>


### [307] [Scalable Concurrent Queues for GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01693)
*Pratheek Prakash Shetty,Thomas R. W. Scogland,Wu-chun Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出三种面向GPU的线性化并发队列：G-WFQ-YMC（无等待，适配自CPU算法）、G-LFQ（无锁，利用波批量快速路径最大化吞吐量）和G-WFQ（无等待，通过64位CAS压缩共享状态），填补了GPU上并发队列研究的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC系统超千万核后，任务分发、负载均衡和资源利用率高度依赖高效并发队列；CPU上并发队列研究充分，但GPU（SIMT执行、大规模并行、原子操作竞争）上的设计空间尚未被探索。

Method: (1) G-WFQ-YMC：适配Yang和Mellor-Crummey的无等待队列，使用预分配段；(2) G-LFQ：有界无锁队列，采用波批量快速路径提升吞吐量；(3) G-WFQ：有界无等待队列，将共享状态压缩到64位CAS操作中，保证线性一致性和有界内存。

Result: 三种队列分别覆盖从无锁到无等待的线性化保证，G-LFQ通过波批量快速路径最大化吞吐量，G-WFQ通过64位CAS压缩实现有界内存的无等待操作。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统探索了GPU上并发队列的设计空间，证明在SIMT和大规模并行环境下，通过有针对性的算法设计（波批量、状态压缩）可以实现高效的线性化并发队列。

Abstract: Concurrent queues can significantly impact supercomputing performance by being critical bottlenecks for task distribution, load balancing, and resource utilization. As HPC systems move beyond 10-million processor cores, the ability to rapidly move items between producer and consumer threads without excessive locking is essential for efficient queues, preventing idle cores, maximizing utilization, and achieving high parallel speedup. While concurrent queues are well studied on CPUs, they remain largely unexplored on modern GPUs, where SIMT execution, massive parallelism, and atomic contention reshape the design space. We present three linearizable GPU concurrent queues spanning from lock-free to wait-free guarantees: (1) G-WFQ-YMC, an adaptation of Yang and Mellor-Crummey's wait-free queue using preallocated segments; (2) G-LFQ, a bounded lock-free queue that uses wave-batched fast paths to maximize throughput; and (3) G-WFQ, a bounded wait-free queue that packs shared state into 64-bit compare-and-swap operations while preserving linearizability and bounded memory.

</details>


### [308] [Night-Window Batching versus Carbon-Aware Scheduling for Clinical AI GPU Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01766)
*Nishi Doshi,Shrey Shah*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 使用GPU进行机器学习任务的医院可通过将非紧急任务调度至夜间（低碳排放时段）运行，在保证临床优先级的前提下减少碳足迹。模拟表明，夜间规则可缩小约78%的碳差距，且比碳优先规则更安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院在GPU上运行机器学习任务时，电网碳强度随时间波动。现有调度策略未充分平衡碳排放、临床紧急性和截止时间合规性，需要探索可行方案。

Method: 通过计算机模拟，在混合GPU硬件上比较13种调度规则，使用合成患者式任务、紧急等级和分时碳足迹数据。关键比较项是夜间非紧急任务调度与混合优先级-碳规则（CUCA_{0.45}）的性能差异。

Result: 夜间规则缩小了约78%的碳差距，且紧急截止时间违规少于其他规则。碳优先规则（CarbonGreedy/CarbonShift）导致约46%紧急任务错过截止时间。地理时区调整影响极小，12小时例行窗口节省少量碳但增加整体截止时间违规。

Conclusion: 夜间批量调度在平均碳足迹上具有竞争力，且能维持临床优先级；碳优先规则仅适用于压力测试，不适合生产环境。

Abstract: Hospitals run more machine learning on GPUs while the carbon footprint of grid electricity rises and falls through the day. Using a computer simulation, we compare $13$ scheduling rules on mixed GPU hardware, with synthetic patient-style jobs, urgency tiers, and time-of-day carbon traces. We do not study patient outcomes; every percentage we report is a simulator queue number, not a clinical finding. We ask whether running non-urgent jobs overnight is almost as good as a richer rule that mixes urgency and carbon (CUCA at weight 0.45, written CUCA$_{0.45}$). The comparison keeps carbon reduction secondary to clinical priority and deadline compliance, so each policy is judged on both average kg CO$_2$e and missed-deadline behavior. CarbonGreedy and CarbonShift are carbon-first stress tests that demonstrate how poorly wrong vendor presets can disrupt clinical priorities, and are not meant for production. Numbers are averages over many test settings, with wide run-to-run spread and no statistical adjustment, so headline ratios are exploratory. On an eight-GPU baseline, the overnight rule closes about $78\%$ of the carbon gap between urgency-only and CUCA$_{0.45}$ while missing fewer urgent deadlines than either. CarbonShift lets about $46\%$ of the most urgent jobs miss their deadline; this is simulated queueing, not bedside harm. At $48$ jobs per hour, the carbon footprints almost tie, yet the overnight rule still misses fewer urgent deadlines. A geography test, where regions share one daily carbon shape with only timezone shifts, trims under one percentage point of average carbon; a twelve-hour routine window saves a little carbon for CUCA$_{0.45}$ but raises overall missed deadlines. Overnight batching stays competitive on average modelled carbon; carbon-only rules belong only in stress tests.

</details>


### [309] [Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01839)
*Jianru Ding,Ryien Hosseini,Pouya Mahdi Gholami,Mingyuan Xiang,Henry Hoffmann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出以对话（conversation）而非单轮（turn）作为LLM agent系统的调度单元，从而将不稳定的轮次级别负载转化为稳定的两阶段结构（计算密集型首轮预填充+内存密集型长尾解码），并据此设计ConServe系统，在无需预测的情况下显著降低p95首有效token延迟51.08%并提升能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮LLM agent系统以轮次为调度单元，需要预测每轮的解码长度、工具行为和KV增长等不可观测量来决策是否分离预填充与解码，这种对预测的依赖带来了系统复杂度和性能不确定性。作者希望消除这种预测依赖，通过改变调度单元来直接利用可观测的负载特征。

Method: 提出以对话为调度单元的原则，将轮次级别的不规则性转化为稳定的两阶段结构：第一轮预填充（计算密集型）和后续长尾解码（内存密集型）。据此设计ConServe系统：将首轮预填充路由到高吞吐预填充器，KV缓存仅传输一次，整个对话的后续解码固定到单一解码器，无需学习解码侧成本模型。

Result: 相比基于逐轮预测的基线，ConServe将p95 time-to-first-effective-token（对话首个用户可见输出的延迟）降低51.08%，能效提升7.51%，同时保持最后轮次的TBT（token间延迟）和SLO。将两阶段映射到异构GPU层级可进一步增加22.75%的能效提升。

Conclusion: 将调度单元从轮次提升到对话，可以将不可预测的负载转化为可观测的稳定两阶段结构，从而在无需预测的情况下实现更优的延迟和能效表现，验证了调度单元选择对系统性能的根本性影响。

Abstract: LLM-based agents resolve a user task through many turns of dependent inference and tool calls, producing a workload whose total cost is unknown when the task arrives. Existing multi-turn systems keep the turn as the scheduling unit and decide, turn by turn, whether to disaggregate prefill from decode. That decision rests on the turn's decode length, tool behavior, and KV growth, quantities that are not observable when the scheduler must act, forcing the system to predict them. We show this dependence on prediction is imposed by the scheduling unit, not the workload. Raising the scheduling unit from the turn to the conversation converts turn-level irregularity into a stable, two-phase structure: 1) a compute-bound turn-1 prefill followed by 2) a long, memory-bound tail. Thus, with the conversation as the scheduling unit, placement reduces to reading the first-turn input length and per-decoder KV occupancy, both directly observable. We instantiate this principle in ConServe, which routes the first-turn prefill to a high-throughput prefiller, transfers the KV cache exactly once, and pins the conversation to a single decoder for its entire tail, with no learned model of decode-side cost. Against a per-turn prediction baseline, ConServe reduces p95 time-to-first-effective-token (the latency of a conversation's first user-visible output) by 51.08% and improves energy efficiency by 7.51% while preserving last-turn TBT and SLOs; mapping the two phases onto heterogeneous GPU tiers adds a further 22.75% in energy efficiency.

</details>


### [310] [Parallelizing Large-Scale Tensor Network Contraction on Multiple GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01852)
*Feng Pan,Hanfeng Gu,Paul Springer,Xipeng Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种多GPU框架，通过显式通信分布中间张量，将固定收缩路径转换为通信高效调度，在单节点NVLink环境下获得7-173倍加速，在1024 GPU InfiniBand集群上获得42-67869倍加速，远超传统切片策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统张量网络收缩的并行化策略（切片）存在指数级扩展和冗余计算问题，亟需更高效的分布式方法。

Method: 多GPU框架，将中间张量分布到设备间并进行显式通信；通过GEMM导向的模式重排序和通信感知的模式分布规划，将固定收缩路径转换为通信高效调度。

Result: 单节点（8 GPU，NVLink）获得7-173倍额外加速，捕获87-101%的计算缩减；扩展到1024 H100 GPU（InfiniBand）获得42-67869倍额外加速。

Conclusion: 通信感知的分布式张量网络收缩远超市面切片策略的扩展极限，适用于前沿张量网络。

Abstract: Exact tensor network contraction underpins quantum circuit simulation, quantum error correction, combinatorial optimization, and many-body dynamics. The dominant parallelization strategy, slicing, scales exponentially and incurs redundant computation. We present a multi-GPU framework that instead distributes intermediate tensors across devices with explicit communication, converting a fixed contraction path into a communication-efficient schedule via GEMM-oriented mode reordering and communication-aware mode distribution planning. Within a single DGX H100 node (8 GPUs, NVLink), distribution delivers $7$--$173\times$ extra speedup beyond embarrassingly parallel slicing, capturing nearly all of the available compute reduction (87--101%) because NVLink's high bandwidth keeps communication small relative to compute. Scaling the same four workloads to 1024 H100 GPUs over InfiniBand, the extra speedup beyond slicing ranges from $42\times$ to $67{,}869\times$, demonstrating that communication-aware distributed contraction far surpasses slicing-based scaling limits for frontier tensor networks.

</details>


### [311] [Boosting Multimodal Federated Learning via Chained Modality Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01856)
*Zixin Zhang,Fan Qi,Shuai Li,Xiaoshan Yang,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FedMChain提出了一种分阶段的多模态联邦学习框架，通过模态级优化窗口和误差补偿正则化缓解模态竞争，结合稀疏符号引导聚合策略，在减少通信频率的同时提升了模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MMFL方法将多模态训练视为联合优化问题，忽视了"模态竞争"这一关键瓶颈——主导模态抑制弱势模态，导致全局模型次优。

Method: 1) 将联邦多模态训练构建为模态链式分阶段框架，为每种模态分配独立的本地优化窗口；2) 引入误差补偿正则化器促进跨模态互补性；3) 在服务器端采用稀疏符号引导聚合策略，利用方向性符号一致性进行鲁棒聚合，避免破坏性平均，并支持低频率同步。

Result: 在多模态基准测试上，FedMChain在需要比基线更少通信频率的条件下，持续提升了预测性能。

Conclusion: FedMChain通过分阶段设计和符号引导聚合，有效解决了多模态联邦学习中的模态竞争问题，实现了性能提升与通信效率的双重优化。

Abstract: Multimodal Federated Learning (MMFL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative learning across decentralized clients with heterogeneous data and modality availability. However, most existing MMFL methods cast multimodal training as a joint optimization problem, overlooking a key bottleneck: modality competition, where dominant modalities suppress weaker ones and lead to suboptimal global models. To address this, we propose FedMChain, a balanced MMFL framework that structures federated multimodal training as a chain of modality-wise phases. This phase-wise design gives each modality a dedicated local optimization window on multimodal clients to mitigate modality competition, and further promotes cross-modal complementarity via an error-compensated regularizer. On the server side, we employ a sparse sign-guided aggregation strategy that leverages directional sign agreement for robust intra-modality aggregation, avoids destructive averaging, and supports less frequent synchronization to reduce communication overhead. Extensive experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that FedMChain consistently improves predictive performance while requiring less frequent communication than baselines.

</details>


### [312] [Scaling LLM Inference Beyond Amdahl`s Limits via Eliminating Non-Scalable Overheads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01927)
*Alan Zhao,Cyril Y. He,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Albireo是一个并行推理系统，通过重叠调度和I/O与计算、以及序列并行采样，在不改变模型架构的情况下提高最优张量并行度，相比vLLM实现最高1.9倍吞吐量提升、48%延迟降低、28% GPU利用率提升和54%能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线LLM服务部署者通常在固定GPU数量下追求最大化集群性能。张量并行度t增大时，由于跨GPU通信和不可扩展运行时开销（Amdahl定律），性能呈亚线性增长；但增大t可提升内存效率并减少KV-cache争用与交换。需要平衡这些效应以找到经验最优TP度t_e。

Method: 识别并验证了经验最优张量并行度t_e；提出Albireo系统，通过将调度和I/O与计算重叠、以及序列并行采样，缩小不可扩展部分，从而提升可达的t_e，且不改变模型架构。

Result: 跨模型和基准测试：相比vLLM，Albireo实现最高1.9倍吞吐量提升、48%延迟降低、28% GPU利用率提升和54%能耗降低；生产环境中实现最高2倍吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: 通过重叠调度和I/O与计算及序列并行采样，Albireo有效提升了最优张量并行度，显著提高了LLM推理系统的吞吐量、延迟、GPU利用率和能效。

Abstract: Deployers of online LLM services usually seek to maximize cluster-wide performance given a fixed number of GPUs. Tensor parallelism (TP) is necessary to fit modern models but scales sub-linearly as the TP degree t grows, due to cross-GPU communication and non-scalable runtime work, as predicted by Amdahl's Law. Conversely, increasing t improves memory efficiency and alleviates KV-cache contention and swapping. We identify and validate an empirical optimal TP degree t_e that balances these effects. We present Albireo, a parallel inference system that raises the attainable t_e by shrinking the non-scalable portion via overlap of scheduling and I/O with compute and sequence-parallel sampling, without changing model architectures. Across models and benchmarks, Albireo achieves up to 1.9x higher throughput, 48% lower latency, 28% higher GPU utilization, and 54% lower energy than vLLM; in production it yields up to 2x higher throughput.

</details>


### [313] [TAPAAL SMC: Statistical Model Checking of Stochastic Timed-Arc Petri Nets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02007)
*Tanguy Dubois,Kim G. Larsen,Jiri Srba*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文首次为Timed-Arc Petri网（TAPN）定义了随机语义，并在模型检查器TAPAAL中实现了定量与定性的统计模型检验（SMC）算法，通过案例研究证明了其实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TAPN具有强大的建模能力（时间区间、位置不变量、抑制弧、传输弧），但验证问题往往计算困难甚至不可判定；同时，实际系统建模需要引入随机行为。现有工作缺乏TAPN的随机语义。

Method: 提出TAPN的首个随机语义，论证语义选择的合理性和良好性质；在TAPAAL中设计并实现了统计模型检验（SMC）算法，包括定量（概率估计）和定性（假设检验）两类。

Result: 通过多个案例研究展示了所提随机语义及SMC实现的实用性和有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的TAPN随机语义具有良好行为性质，SMC实现能够有效处理实际系统的建模与验证需求。

Abstract: Timed-Arc Petri net (TAPN) is a timed extension of the classical Petri net model where tokens have their age and input arcs are associated with time intervals restricting the ages of tokens available for transition firing. Additionally, a TAPN can also contain place invariants constraining the ages of tokens in places, inhibitor arcs preventing a transition from firing and transport arcs that preserve token ages upon firing. This set of features, as much as it allows us to model complex systems, also often makes verification problems computationally hard or even undecidable. Moreover, in order to model real-life examples, additional stochastic aspects are often necessary to capture the desired behaviour. We suggest the first stochastic semantics for TAPNs and design and implement the quantitative and qualitative Statistical Model Checking (SMC) algorithms in the model checker TAPAAL. We argue for the semantic choices we made in the stochastic semantics and prove that the semantics is well-behaving. On a number of case studies we demonstrate the practical applicability of our modelling formalism and its SMC implementation.

</details>


### [314] [EES-CND: Collaborative Neural Decision-Making for Drift-Aware Fault-Tolerant Edge-Cloud Service Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02259)
*Mohammadsadeq Garshasbi Herabad,Javid Taheri,Bestoun S. Ahmed,Calin Curescu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向边云环境的容错服务放置方法EES-CND，采用多轻量级神经网络协同决策与增强进化策略在线更新，在服务恢复时间、响应时间和可靠性方面显著优于现有方法，容错成本降低44.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边云环境因规模大、异构性强、动态条件复杂，硬件故障、软件缺陷等问题频发，导致系统配置紊乱、服务执行中断，进而降低可靠性、引发性能退化并违反服务质量目标。现有方法难以有效应对这些故障带来的性能漂移问题。

Method: 提出EES-CND方法：1）采用多个轻量级神经网络协同决策，在故障事件发生时联合推断重部署策略；2）利用增强进化策略在线更新自适应模型，以应对系统动态性并缓解性能漂移。

Result: 大量仿真实验表明，EES-CND能够有效处理性能漂移，在服务恢复时间、响应时间和可靠性方面显著优于现有方法，容错成本相比独立模型降低44.8%。

Conclusion: EES-CND作为一种自适应容错服务放置方法，在边云环境中能有效保障服务执行的连续性和可靠性，显著降低容错成本，验证了协同决策与进化策略相结合的可行性。

Abstract: The edge-cloud paradigm improves service delivery by orchestrating resources across edge nodes and cloud data centres. These environments consist of heterogeneous, interconnected computing nodes that cooperate to deliver continuous services. However, their scale and complexity increase vulnerability to failures from hardware malfunctions, software defects, and dynamic operating conditions. These failures can disrupt system configurations and service execution, leading to reduced reliability, performance degradation, and violations of service-level objectives. Ensuring service execution requires adaptive service placement strategies across edge-cloud resources. This study introduces a fault-tolerant service placement approach (Enhanced Evolution Strategy for Collaborative Neural Decision-making, EES-CND) for edge-cloud environments. The method employs collaborative decision-making, wherein multiple lightweight neural networks jointly infer redeployment strategies during failure events. To address the system dynamics and mitigate performance drift, adaptive models are updated online using an enhanced evolution strategy. Extensive simulations show that EES-CND effectively handles performance drift and significantly outperforms existing methods in service recovery time, response time, and reliability, achieving a 44.8\% reduction in fault-tolerance cost compared to standalone models.

</details>


### [315] [Strategies for Molecular Dynamics using Hybrid Systems: LAMMPS Use Case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02319)
*Paulo Henrique Leme Ramalho,Dennis Alves Pedersen,Fábio Andrijauskas*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对LAMMPS模拟器在粗粒化生物分子模拟中的性能与可扩展性进行了系统分析，以抗菌肽Tritrpticin为实验负载，比较了纯MPI与混合MPI+OpenMP两种并行策略在HPC环境中的表现。结果表明纯MPI在单节点表现优异，但多节点时因通信开销可扩展性下降；混合MPI+OpenMP在大规模下更高效，能降低通信成本并更好利用NUMA内存层次结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子模拟复杂性的增长对高性能计算基础设施提出了更高需求，特别是在分子动力学和粗粒化建模领域，因此需要系统评估不同并行策略在粗粒化生物分子模拟中的性能表现。

Method: 以抗菌肽Tritrpticin为实验负载，在最多8个计算节点、1024个并发核心的HPC环境中，分别评估纯MPI和混合MPI+OpenMP两种并行执行方式，测量执行时间、加速比、并行效率、统计变异性和内部时间分解等指标。

Result: 纯MPI在单节点环境中表现优异，但在多节点执行中因通信开销和进程间同步导致可扩展性下降；混合MPI+OpenMP配置在大规模下更高效，能降低通信成本并更好利用NUMA层次结构；通信和静电相互作用例程在大规模纯MPI中占执行时间最大比例。

Conclusion: 生物分子HPC应用的性能直接取决于并行化粒度、空间分解和分布式通信成本之间的平衡；混合MPI+OpenMP策略是粗粒化生物分子模拟在现代化众核架构上更可持续的替代方案。

Abstract: The complexity of biomolecular simulations has substantially increased the demand for High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructures, particularly in molecular dynamics and coarse-grained modeling. This work presents a systematic performance and scalability analysis of the LAMMPS simulator for coarse-grained biomolecular simulations, using the antimicrobial peptide Tritrpticin (PDB ID: 1D6X) as the experimental workload. Pure MPI and hybrid MPI+OpenMP executions were evaluated in HPC environments comprising up to 8 compute nodes and 1024 simultaneous cores. Metrics of execution time, speedup, parallel efficiency, statistical variability, and internal time decomposition were investigated. Results showed that pure MPI executions deliver excellent performance in single-node environments but suffer scalability degradation in multi-node executions due to communication overhead and inter-process synchronization. Hybrid MPI+OpenMP configurations proved more efficient at large scale, reducing communication costs and better exploiting the NUMA memory hierarchy. The computational breakdown revealed that communication and electrostatic interaction routines accounted for the largest fraction of execution time at the largest pure-MPI scales. These results reinforce that performance of biomolecular HPC applications depends directly on the balance among parallelization granularity, spatial decomposition, and distributed communication costs. Hybrid MPI+OpenMP strategies represent a more sustainable alternative for coarse-grained biomolecular simulations on modern many-core architectures.

</details>


### [316] [Not All Errors Are Equal: A Systematic Study of Error Propagation in Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02430)
*Yafan Huang,Sheng Di,Guanpeng Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了LLMFI——一个可配置、确定性的故障注入框架，系统研究了LLM推理过程中软错误的传播机制。通过在三个开源LLM和13种代表性任务上注入故障，覆盖推理、多语言、数学和代码生成等领域，并结合细粒度案例分析，得出了17项关于LLM推理错误传播的关键发现，并提出了四种低开销的纯软件可靠性改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正被广泛应用于HPC工作流中，但软错误如何影响LLM推理过程仍缺乏系统性研究，存在研究空白。

Method: 设计并实现LLMFI框架：一种可配置、确定性的故障注入框架。在三个开源权重LLM上，面向推理、多语言、数学、代码等13种任务进行系统性故障注入实验，并结合细粒度案例分析。

Result: 获得17项关于LLM推理错误传播的关键发现，识别出关键的脆弱性模式，并提出四种低开销的纯软件可靠性改进方向。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了LLM推理中软错误传播机制的研究空白，为未来错误检测与缓解提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into high-performance computing (HPC) workflows, accelerating scientific discovery through diverse perspectives such as code generation and domain-specific decision-making. Yet, how soft errors propagate and affect LLM inference remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive study on error propagation in LLM inference, enabled by our proposed LLMFI, a configurable and deterministic fault-injection framework. Using LLMFI, we systematically inject faults across three open-weighted LLMs and thirteen representative tasks, covering reasoning, multilingual, mathematical, and coding domains. In addition, we conduct fine-grained case studies that reveal critical vulnerability patterns. Overall, our study yields 17 takeaways that advance the understanding of error propagation in LLM inference and introduces four low-overhead directions to improve reliability through software-only modification, offering practical guidance for future error detection and mitigation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [317] [Position Paper: Post-Solve Robustness in Decision Engines: Feasible Regions and Smoothness Under Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00002)
*Yi-Xiang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在MILP决策引擎的求解后阶段增加一个鲁棒性审计层，通过形式化ε-近优可行邻域和决策空间解平滑度两个核心对象，综合敏感性分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和基于学习的增强方法，建立统一的求解后鲁棒性评估框架，使鲁棒性成为决策引擎的一等输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前MILP决策引擎输出的名义最优解在实际部署中面临参数扰动（成本、需求、资源可用性等）导致的可行性失效或解空间不连续跳变问题，而现有的优化流程缺乏对求解后鲁棒性的系统性评估，学习型决策系统也缺少这一评价维度。

Method: 形式化定义了两个核心对象：(i)参数空间的ε-近优可行邻域，刻画解在扰动下保持可行且近优的范围；(ii)决策空间的解平滑度，衡量小组合编辑下竞争解的连续性。综合敏感性分析、稳定性分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和基于学习的方法，提出包括认证内逼近、概率鲁棒性估计、对抗鲁棒性边界、学习预测与解释在内的统一框架。

Result: 提出了一个完整的求解后鲁棒性层架构，包含兼容的报告模板和评估协议，使鲁棒性成为决策引擎的标准输出。

Conclusion: 求解后鲁棒性审计是当前优化流水线中缺失的关键环节，需要将鲁棒性作为决策引擎的一等公民输出，为高安全工业系统的决策可信度提供形式化保障。

Abstract: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) decision engines routinely output nominally optimal plans for high-stakes industrial systems. Yet deployment rarely matches solve-time assumptions: small perturbations in costs, demands, or resource availability can invalidate feasibility or trigger discontinuous shifts to qualitatively different solutions. We argue that this post-solve robustness gap is a missing layer in today's optimization pipelines and a missing evaluation dimension for learning-enabled decision systems. Rather than replacing robust optimization or stochastic programming, the proposed layer audits a solved incumbent and returns solver-backed evidence about how far that solution can be trusted. We formalize two central objects: (i) an $ε$-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing when an incumbent remains feasible and near-optimal under perturbations, and (ii) solution smoothness in decision space, capturing whether nearby alternatives with small combinatorial edits remain competitive. We then synthesize the most relevant partial answers from sensitivity and stability analysis, robust optimization, neighborhood search, adversarial testing, and learning-based enhancements, and articulate an agenda for a unified post-solve robustness layer. Concretely, we call for certified inner approximations around the incumbent, probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty, adversarial robustness margins, and learning-based prediction and explanation aligned with solver-backed verification. We conclude with a compact reporting template and evaluation protocol that would make robustness a first-class output of decision engines.

</details>


### [318] [Emergent Collaborative Deliberation in Multi-Model AI Systems: A BFT-Derived Protocol for Epistemic Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00005)
*VD Doske*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Consilium协议是一种拜占庭容错驱动的多模型AI deliberation架构，通过认知人设分离模型身份与推理方式，并引入样本内/样本外验证框架。在1,478场 deliberation 中证明：认知人设决定认知行为（边缘模型0.0002美元/批次产出可比于前沿模型10.69美元）、RLHF对齐训练导致特定领域认知盲区（政策议题对抗性挑战比科学议题低12.3个百分点）、协议自身无方向性偏差、OOS证据检索100%验证239项声明并发现167项盲区。全程成本217美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模型AI deliberation系统通常将模型间分歧视为错误或噪声，缺乏结构化方法来利用这些分歧作为认知信号。同时，模型的对齐训练（如RLHF）可能导致系统性的认知偏差，影响AI系统的判断可靠性。

Method: 提出Consilium Protocol：1）采用拜占庭容错架构进行多模型结构化deliberation；2）引入认知人设概念，将模型身份与推理方式分离；3）借鉴量化金融的样本内/样本外验证框架区分训练数据共识与经验验证结论。实验设置：1,478场deliberation、32个话题、10个领域类别，使用随机化模型×人设分配。

Result: 1）认知人设而非底层模型决定认知行为，低成本边缘模型产出可媲美昂贵前沿模型；2）RLHF导致领域特异性认知盲区，政策话题比科学话题缺少12.3%的对抗性挑战，AI安全话题存在不对称偏差（11.6%）；3）协议自身无方向性偏差（移民Δ=2.3%，可再生能源Δ=1.2%）；4）OOS证据检索100%验证239项声明并发现167个训练数据不可见的盲区；运行间可重复性标准差±2.2%。

Conclusion: Consilium Protocol为多模型AI deliberation提供了一种低成本、高可靠性的框架，能够有效识别和利用模型间的认知信号，揭示对齐训练的偏差影响，并通过样本外验证确保结论的经验可靠性。协议已在MIT许可下开源。

Abstract: We present the Consilium Protocol, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error. The protocol assigns engineered cognitive personas to language models -- separating what a model is from how it reasons -- and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions. Across 1,478 deliberation sessions spanning 32 topics in 10 domain categories, we demonstrate that (1) the cognitive persona, not the underlying model, determines epistemic behavior: free edge-inference models costing 0.0002 USD per batch produced comparable analytical output to frontier models costing 10.69 USD; (2) RLHF alignment training creates measurable, domain-specific epistemic blind spots -- contested policy topics exhibit 12.3 percentage points less adversarial challenge than settled science topics, and AI safety topics show asymmetric bias ($Δ$=11.6%) where models challenge claims that AI is dangerous far more vigorously than claims that AI risk is overstated; (3) the protocol exhibits no directional bias of its own (immigration $Δ$=2.3%, renewables $Δ$=1.2%); and (4) out-of-sample evidence retrieval validated 239 claims with 100% evidence retrieval and surfaced 167 blind-spot discoveries invisible to training-data deliberation. Run-to-run reproducibility across randomized model$\times$persona assignments averages $\pm$2.2% standard deviation. Total cost for the complete battery including all overhead: 217 USD. We release the protocol specification under MIT license to enable independent verification.

</details>


### [319] [Deliberative Curation: A Protocol for Multi-Agent Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00007)
*Steven Johnson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对AI智能体在共享知识生态中的集体知识策展问题，提出了一种结合知识工件生命周期、声誉加权审议投票和分级制裁的审议策展协议，通过代理模拟验证其在逆境下比多数投票具有更强的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体正从孤立工具向共享知识生态中的协作参与者转变，但人类平台治理机制（威慑制裁、群体智慧、协商共识）因智能体无状态、模型同质化、谄媚问题而无法直接迁移，亟需专门针对AI智能体的集体知识策展治理机制。

Method: 提出三层治理协议：(1) 知识工件生命周期形式化为带标签的迁移系统；(2) 声誉加权审议投票，结合Beta声誉模型与EigenTrust放大；(3) 针对无状态智能体的分级制裁，包括区分故障与对抗行为的故障代理处理。通过100个代理、7种行为原型、两种逆境场景的代理模拟进行评估。

Result: 协议在良性条件下精度略有牺牲，但逆境下鲁棒性显著提升：中等逆境下0.826 vs 0.791（多数投票），p<0.001；高强度逆境下0.807 vs 0.740，p<0.001。协议退化速度约为多数投票的1/3。消融分析显示提交-揭示投票隐藏机制是最关键的单一组件（精度提升8.2-8.6pp，p<0.001）。分级制裁在模拟中未被触发，仍待实证验证。

Conclusion: 该审议策展协议为AI智能体集体知识策展提供了更鲁棒的治理框架，尤其在逆境条件下显著优于传统多数投票机制，但分级制裁的有效性仍需进一步实证研究。

Abstract: As AI agents transition from isolated tools to collaborative participants in shared knowledge ecosystems, governing collective knowledge curation becomes a critical challenge. Human platform governance mechanisms do not transfer directly: agent statelessness undermines deterrence-based sanctions, model homogeneity violates independence assumptions underlying crowd wisdom, and sycophancy collapses deliberative consensus.
  We propose a deliberative curation protocol combining three governance layers: (1) a knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system; (2) reputation-weighted deliberative voting integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification; and (3) graduated sanctions adapted for stateless agents, including broken agent handling distinguishing malfunction from adversarial behavior.
  We evaluate the protocol through agent-based simulation with 100 agents across seven behavioral archetypes under two adversity scenarios (30 seeds, paired t-tests). The protocol trades modest precision under benign conditions for substantially better resilience under adversity: 0.826 vs 0.791 for majority vote under moderate adversity (p<0.001), widening to 0.807 vs 0.740 under stress (p<0.001). The protocol degrades roughly three times more slowly than majority vote. Ablation analysis identifies commit-reveal vote concealment as the most impactful single component (8.2-8.6pp precision improvement, p<0.001), outperforming reputation weighting and deliberation combined. Graduated sanctions were not exercised in simulation and remain empirically unvalidated.

</details>


### [320] [Agents on a Tree: Pathwise Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00008)
*Jia Zhang,Tengfei Ma,Tianle Li,Daojian Zeng,Xieping Gao,Xiangxiang Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ATOM是一个多智能体框架，将分子优化建模为树结构搜索，每个节点对应原子操作并托管专注于特定目标的智能体，通过路径协调而非全局共识来维护和比较多条分子进化轨迹，在多项多目标基准上实现了更优的帕累托覆盖和超体积指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子优化方法通常依赖单一策略或固定标量化，难以在冲突目标下表示多样化的权衡，也无法探索多条有前景的设计轨迹，早期设计决策对后续结果的约束过于严格。

Method: 提出ATOM多智能体框架，将分子优化形式化为树结构搜索。每个节点对应一个原子操作并托管一个专注于特定目标或决策上下文的智能体。智能体沿树的不同路径协调而非强制全局共识，维护并比较多条分子进化轨迹。全局记忆模块记录过去优化行为，以支持跨目标的平衡探索与利用。

Result: 在涉及活性、可合成性和ADMET相关属性的多目标基准上，ATOM在帕累托覆盖和超体积指标上持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 路径式多智能体协调策略能有效处理分子优化中的长程依赖关系，为多目标分子优化提供了一种有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization requires searching vast chemical spaces under conflicting objectives, where early design decisions strongly constrain downstream outcomes. Existing methods typically rely on a single policy or fixed scalarization, which limits their ability to represent diverse trade-offs and to explore multiple promising design trajectories. We propose ATOM, a multi-agent framework that formulates molecular optimization as a tree-structured search. Each node corresponds to an atomic operation and hosts an agent specialized for a particular objective or decision context. Agents coordinate along different paths of the tree rather than enforcing a global consensus, enabling the method to maintain and compare alternative molecular evolution trajectories. A global memory of past optimization behaviors further supports balanced exploration and exploitation across objectives. This tree-structured interaction enables reasoning over long-horizon dependencies inherent in molecular design. Experiments on challenging multi-objective benchmarks involving activity, synthesizability, and ADMET-related properties show that ATOM consistently achieves improved Pareto coverage and hypervolume over strong baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pathwise multi-agent coordination for molecular optimization. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ATOM-41CE.

</details>


### [321] [Optimal Transport-based Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00009)
*Antonio Candelieri,Laurens Bliek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于最优传输理论的排列不变贝叶斯优化方法（PIBO），用于解决布局优化问题（如海上风电场布局），相较标准BO方法能获得更优布局并节省约一半计算时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化无法利用目标问题中可能存在的对称性（如点的顺序不影响目标函数值），导致效率低下。本文旨在解决这类"布局优化"问题中的排列不变性需求。

Method: 基于最优传输理论（Optimal Transport），提出排列不变贝叶斯优化（PIBO），通过引入排列不变性处理决策变量中点的顺序无关性。

Result: PIBO相比标准BO方法能提供更优的风电场布局，并将计算时间大致减半。

Conclusion: PIBO有效利用了布局优化问题的排列对称性，提升了优化性能和计算效率，尤其在海上风电场布局这类工业应用中表现突出。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely and successfully adopted for solving optimization problems having an expensive-to-evaluate, black-box, and non-convex objective function. However, the vanilla BO algorithm is not able to exploit possible symmetries characterizing the target problem. An intuitive case is given by optimal location problems, whose decision variables refer to a finite set of points within a continuous space, with the order of points not affecting the value of the objective function. We refer to this setting as optimization over layouts to distinguish from optimization over point-clouds where, instead, the order of points counts. As an instance of optimization over layouts we consider a real-life industrial-relevant application, that is the optimization of the layout of an offshore wind farm: given identical wind turbines, switching any pair of them has not any effect on the annual energy production. Based on Optimal Transport theory, we propose a Permutation-Invariant BO approach, namely PIBO, proved to provide better wind farm layouts when compared to the vanilla BO approach while cutting computation time roughly in half.

</details>


### [322] [MindGames Arena Generalization Track: In2AI Solution with Delayed Per-Step Reward Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00017)
*Aliaksei Korshuk,Alexander Buyantuev,Ilya Makarov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种延迟逐步骤奖励归因与资格门控方法，结合异步rollout生成、基于课程的对手采样和多级分层批次构建，实现了多智能体策略交互场景下的稳定、样本高效强化学习训练。使用8B开源模型在MindGames Arena基准测试中击败了包括GPT-5在内的更大规模专有系统，在两项赛道中均获第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体策略交互中，标准强化学习的逐步骤奖励假设不成立，因为动作质量依赖于未发生的未来事件、违反游戏规则的移动或其他玩家的决策，导致奖励在时间和智能体间纠缠，难以有效训练语言模型智能体。

Method: 提出延迟逐步骤奖励归因与资格门控（delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating），包括：仅在回合结束时计算奖励，根据任务语义将奖励回溯到原始步骤，排除缺乏有效依赖信息的步骤。配合vLLM连续批处理的异步rollout生成、基于课程的对手采样和多级分层批次构建。

Result: 在NeurIPS 2025的MindGames Arena基准测试中，一个8B参数的模型匹配或超越了包括GPT-5在内的更大规模专有系统，在Open和Efficient两项赛道中均获第一。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够有效解决多智能体策略交互中的奖励分配难题，使小规模开源模型在复杂对抗环境下达到甚至超越大规模专有系统的性能，验证了方法的稳定性和样本效率。

Abstract: Training language model agents for multi-agent strategic interaction presents a core difficulty: the quality of any action may depend on future events that never materialize, on moves that violate game rules, or on decisions made by other players. Standard reinforcement learning assumes that rewards can be assigned at each step, but this assumption fails in settings where outcomes are entangled across time and agents. We introduce delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating, an episode lifecycle and postprocessing pipeline that computes rewards only at episode end, propagates them back to originating steps according to task-specific semantics, and excludes steps that lack valid dependent information from training. Together with asynchronous rollout generation via vLLM's continuous batching, curriculum-based opponent sampling, and multi-level stratified batch construction, this approach enables stable, sample-efficient RL training in multi-agent environments. We evaluate on the MindGames Arena benchmark at NeurIPS 2025, where a single 8-billion-parameter open-source model trained with our method matched or surpassed substantially larger proprietary systems, including GPT-5, in head-to-head play and took first place in both the Open (unrestricted) and Efficient (<=8B parameters) tracks.

</details>


### [323] [Universal Quantum Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00045)
*Sungyong Chung,Alireza Talebpour*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出通用量子变换器(UQT)，一种基于多量子比特系统物理特性的量子原生计算架构，利用参数化几何相位嵌入和SU(2)波干涉实现精确的数学与代数推理。在5量子比特上，UQT完美学习了循环模算术(Z_{11})和非阿贝尔代数(S_4置换群)，实现了确定性泛化，超越了经典网络的随机不稳定性和"grokking"现象，作者称此为"结晶化"。该架构在理论和NISQ硬件上均证明了其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典连续空间神经网络难以锁定精确的数学对称性（如模算术和非交换代数），即使通过大规模参数缩放和延迟泛化（grokking）也只能达到随机不稳定性。作者旨在寻找一种能够实现精确数学推理的计算架构。

Method: 提出UQT架构，完全依赖参数化几何相位嵌入和SU(2)波干涉，而非翻译经典神经机制。量子注意力电路运行在紧凑的5量子比特基板上，利用多量子比特系统的物理特性作为通用归纳偏置。

Result: UQT在两种高度不同的形式类（循环模算术Z_{11}和非阿贝尔代数S_4置换群）上实现了数学精确的确定性泛化，而经典注意力网络在收敛时表现出随机不稳定性。理论上绕过了经典自注意力的二次瓶颈，并将所需表示维度对数压缩，消除了过度参数化。在IBM量子计算机的NISQ硬件上验证了可行性。

Conclusion: 参数化量子拓扑被确立为精确人工智能的通用优越物理基板，"结晶化"现象超越了经典的grokking，标志着量子原生架构在数学推理领域的关键突破。

Abstract: Classical continuous-space neural networks fundamentally struggle to lock into exact mathematical symmetries, such as modular arithmetic and non-commutative algebra. To approximate these discrete logical rules, they often rely on massive parameter scaling, resulting in stochastic instability even after delayed generalization phenomena known as grokking. Here, we introduce the Universal Quantum Transformer (UQT), a fundamentally novel, quantum-native computing architecture that uses the physical properties of multi-qubit systems as a universal inductive bias for exact mathematical and algebraic reasoning. Rather than translating classical neural mechanisms, our framework relies entirely on parameterized geometric phase embedding and $SU(2)$ wave-interference. We demonstrate that the quantum attention circuit, operating on a highly compact 5-qubit substrate, perfectly learns two highly distinct formal classes: cyclic modular arithmetic ($\mathbb{Z}_{11}$) and non-Abelian algebra (the $S_4$ permutation group). While classical attention-based networks exhibit stochastic instability at convergence, the UQT achieves mathematically exact, deterministic generalization. We refer to this phenomenon as crystallization: a step beyond the well-known phenomenon of grokking. Crucially, this framework yields massive computational and memory advantages by theoretically bypassing the quadratic bottleneck of classical self-attention, and by logarithmically compressing the required representation dimension to eliminate the massive over-parameterization inherent to classical networks. Finally, we deploy this architecture on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, proving its viability on current IBM Quantum computers. These results establish parameterized quantum topology as a universally superior physical substrate for exact artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [324] [Grokers: Bottom-Up Inductive Comprehension and Write-Time Intelligence over Typed Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00050)
*Gregory Magarshak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Grokers提出了一种通过自底向上归纳遍历依赖子图来构建持久化、结构化知识图谱理解的架构。与RAG每次查询都需支付完整理解成本不同，Grokers将智能推向写入阶段：自治的Groker代理分析类型流图中的节点，通过受控的LM调用提取结构化属性，并沿依赖关系向上归纳组合理解，写入富化类型属性，使得所有未来查询零额外LM成本。论文证明了三个形式化定理，并提出了一种确定性替代嵌入的语义搜索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG方法每次查询都需要重新调用LM进行理解，成本高昂且无法累积知识。亟需一种架构能够在写入阶段一次性完成结构化理解，使后续查询无需额外LM调用，从而实现知识的持久化积累和零成本复用。

Method: Grokers架构包含三个核心组件：(1) 自治Groker代理通过自底向上的方式遍历类型流图的依赖子图，提取并结构化属性；(2) 事务性维护的反正化索引确保上下文块在语义变化间字节一致，实现KV缓存命中率接近100%；(3) 确定性同义缓存协议替代嵌入语义搜索，LM回退率在有限词汇域中趋近于零。

Result: 形式化证明了三个定理：字节同一性定理保证KV缓存高效复用；累积单调性定理保证无LM调用比例随交互次数单调非减；双遍历顺序定理证明自顶向下生成与自底向上理解是DAG上各自任务的唯一正确遍历顺序，且两者组合形成完整的生成-理解闭环。同义缓存协议的LM回退率在有限词汇域中收敛到零。

Conclusion: Grokers通过将知识理解成本从查询阶段转移到写入阶段，实现了结构化知识的持久化累积和零成本复用，是对RAG范式的一种根本性替代方案。其形式化保证和开源实现为构建大规模、高效、可扩展的知识图谱理解系统提供了理论基础和实践工具。

Abstract: We present Grokers, an architecture for building persistent, structured comprehension of typed knowledge graphs through bottom-up inductive traversal of dependency subgraphs. Unlike retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which pays full comprehension cost at every query, Grokers pushes intelligence to write time: autonomous Groker agents analyze nodes in a typed stream graph, extract structured attributes via governed language model (LM) calls, and inductively compose that understanding upward through dependency relations, writing enriched typed attributes that serve all future queries at zero additional LM cost. We prove three formal properties: (1) the Byte-Identity Theorem, establishing that context blocks assembled from a transactionally-maintained denormalization index are byte-identical across LM turns between semantic changes, enabling KV-cache hit rates approaching 100%; (2) the Accumulation Monotonicity Theorem, establishing that the fraction of interactions resolved without LM calls is non-decreasing in the number of completed interactions under a governed wisdom library growth protocol; and (3) the Dual-Traversal Ordering Theorem, establishing that top-down generation and bottom-up comprehension are the unique correct traversal orderings for their respective tasks over a dependency DAG, and that their composition closes into a complete generation-comprehension cycle. We further present a deterministic alternative to embedding-based semantic search, with a synonym caching protocol whose LM fallback rate converges to zero for finite-vocabulary domains. A reference implementation is provided in the open-source Qbix / Safebox / Safebots stack.

</details>


### [325] [Product-Aware Deep Autoencoders for Robust Process Monitoring in Multi-Product Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00052)
*MD Shafikul Islam,Jordan Carden*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出工业4.0环境下，传统全局异常检测模型在多产品等级制造中存在"盲区"漏洞，易受隐蔽攻击；提出了一种产品感知自编码器（Product-Aware Autoencoder），通过限制学习域到特定产品等级分布来缓解该风险。在扩展田纳西伊斯曼过程基准上的实验表明，产品感知框架在标准检测指标上与全局基线相当，但在压力测试中，全局模型在77.8%的场景下未能检测到操作偏差，而产品感知系统达到了100%的检测准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前数据驱动的异常检测方法通常采用"产品无关"的全局模型，但现代工业设施常运行于多种产品等级下。全局模型为适应多模式方差而扩展决策边界，产生了"盲区"，使细微异常或针对性的网络物理攻击可能被模型的宽接受区域所掩盖。

Method: 提出Product-Aware Autoencoder方法，将学习域限制在特定产品等级分布上，而非所有正常数据的聚合。在扩展Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP)基准上进行了验证，与Global Agnostic基线进行对比。

Result: 产品感知框架在标准检测指标上与全局基线表现相当；在压力测试中，全局模型在77.8%的场景下未检测到操作偏差，而产品感知系统达到了100%的检测准确率。

Conclusion: 在柔性制造环境中，通用异常检测器可能带来非平凡的安全风险，应转向模式感知的诊断架构。

Abstract: As Industry 4.0 accelerates the integration of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) in manufacturing, robust anomaly detection has become critical for ensuring process safety and security. Current data-driven approaches typically employ "product-agnostic" or global models trained on the aggregate of all normal operating data. However, modern industrial facilities frequently operate under diverse product grades. While computationally simple, these global models inherently expand their decision boundaries to accommodate the variance of multiple modes, creating a "blind spot" where subtle anomalies or targeted cyber-physical attacks may be masked by the wide acceptance region of the model. In this work, we first demonstrate that the vulnerability described above is present in global-agnostic models operating across multiple product grades. We then present a Product-Aware Autoencoder as a principled mitigation that restricts the learning domain to grade-specific distributions. While this approach reduces the identified blind-spot risk, we do not claim it as the optimal mitigation among all possible alternatives. We rigorously validate this approach against a Global Agnostic baseline using the Extended Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) benchmark. Our empirical results indicate that the Product-Aware framework performs comparably to the global baseline on standard detection metrics, while offering improved robustness to product-grade-specific operating modes. Most critically, stress tests simulating our hypothetical attack scenarios reveal that while the global model fails to detect operational deviations in 77.8% of the scenarios, the product-aware system achieves 100% detection accuracy. These findings suggest that, in flexible manufacturing environments, generalized anomaly detectors can pose non-trivial security risks, motivating a shift toward mode-aware diagnostic architectures.

</details>


### [326] [On the evolution of the concept of probability as a mirror of the evolution of reason](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00102)
*Jean-Louis Le Mouël,Vincent Courtillot,Dominique Gibert,Vladimir Kossobokov,Jean-Baptiste Boulé,Pierpaolo Zuddas,Fernando Lopes,Païkan Marccagi,Alexis Maineult*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从历史与认识论视角梳理了概率论从博弈计算到不确定性推理框架的演变，指出其最终成熟形式为Tarantola的贝叶斯信息逻辑，但同时揭示了概率无法形式化概念模糊性的局限。文章进而探讨模糊逻辑与深度学习作为概率之外的理性扩展，主张当代科学理性需同时整合不确定性、模糊性与显式推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文不满足于对概率论作纯数学史的描述，而是试图将其演化理解为"理性本身"的转型，并追问：概率框架的边界在哪里？超越概率的理性形态是什么？

Method: 采用历史认识论方法，沿时间线（帕斯卡/费马→贝叶斯/拉普拉斯→泊松→柯尔莫哥洛夫→现代贝叶斯推理）梳理概率论的发展，并引入塔兰托拉的"概率作为信息逻辑"观点作为成熟形态，再通过与模糊逻辑和深度学习的比较分析来揭示概率的边界。

Result: 概率论成功地将不确定性、时间和一致性纳入科学判断，但无法形式化描述概念本身的模糊性；模糊逻辑提供了处理渐变意义和定性判断的严格语言，深度学习则基于几何插值与优化形成了与显式推理不同的预测模式。

Conclusion: 当代科学理性不能简化为数据驱动的性能，而需要不确定性、模糊性和推理三者的显式 articulation（明晰表达）。概率、模糊逻辑与深度学习各有其角色与局限，共同构成更完整的理性图景。

Abstract: Over the centuries, probability theory has grown from the calculus of games of chance into a central framework for reasoning under uncertainty. This article interprets that evolution not merely as a mathematical history, but as a transformation of rationality itself. From Pascal and Fermat's combinatorial symmetry to the inductive logic of Bayes and Laplace, from Poisson's statistics of events to Kolmogorov's axiomatic formalization, probability progressively incorporated uncertainty, time, and coherence into scientific judgment. This trajectory reaches a mature epistemological form in modern Bayesian inference, especially in Tarantola's view of probability as a logic of information, where prior knowledge and data are combined coherently. Yet this framework also exposes a limit: probability quantifies uncertainty about well-defined propositions, but does not by itself formalize the vagueness of the concepts used to describe them. The article therefore examines how rationality extends beyond probability. Fuzzy logic is presented as a rigorous language for graded meaning and qualitative judgment, while deep learning is analyzed as a distinct, powerful mode of prediction based on geometric interpolation and optimization rather than explicit inference. By situating probability, fuzzy logic, and deep learning in a common historical and epistemological perspective, the article clarifies their roles and limits. It argues that contemporary scientific rationality cannot be reduced to data-driven performance alone, but requires the explicit articulation of uncertainty, vagueness, and inference.

</details>


### [327] [Evaluating Interactive Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Hierarchical Benchmark with Executable Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00103)
*Mingyuan Fan,Weiguang Han,Daixin Wang,Cen Chen,Zhiqiang Zhang,Jun Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个多轮交互式推理评估框架，将推理视为主动证据获取和信念更新过程，构建了包含474个可执行游戏的基准，评估了前沿LLM在成功率、交互效率、上下文鲁棒性和元认知适应方面的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理评估方法多为静态问答，忽略了真实推理场景中主动获取信息、整合部分观察并更新信念的动态过程。

Method: 设计多轮交互框架，LLM仅获知任务规则，需向隐藏环境发出定向查询，随时间整合部分观测，并决定何时提交最终答案。实例化为包含474个可执行游戏的基准，每个游戏在五个难度级别下评估。

Result: 基准具有高区分度，揭示了LLM在成功率和交互效率上的显著差异。上下文扰动导致中等但一致的性能下降，而反事实修正和必要性判断导致更大幅度的下降。

Conclusion: 该框架有效评估了LLM的主动推理能力，元认知适应任务（反事实修正和必要性判断）对模型更具挑战性。

Abstract: We introduce a multi-turn interactive framework for reasoning evaluation that treats reasoning as active evidence acquisition and belief updating. Wherein, LLMs receive only the task rules, must issue targeted queries to a hidden environment, integrate partial observations over time, and decide when to submit a final answer. Beyond standard success rate and interaction efficiency, we evaluate contextual robustness under controlled contextual perturbations, and metacognitive adaptation through counterfactual revision and necessity judgment. We instantiate the framework as a benchmark of 474 executable games, each evaluated under five fixed configuration search spaces corresponding to five difficulty levels, and evaluate a broad set of frontier LLMs. Results show that the benchmark is highly discriminative, exposing large differences not only in success rate but also in interaction efficiency. Moreover, we empirically show that contextual perturbations cause moderate but consistent declines, whereas counterfactual revision and necessity judgment lead to much larger drops.

</details>


### [328] [A Multi-AI-agent Framework Enabling End-to-end Finite Element Analysis for Solid Mechanics Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00138)
*Titu Ranjan Sarker,Muhammed Jawaad Zulqernine,Ling Yue,Shaowu Pan,Chenxi Wang,Shiyao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了AbaqusAgent，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，可将自然语言指令转化为Abaqus有限元分析。该框架由六个智能体组成，覆盖前处理和后处理全流程，在50个固体力学问题上达到86%的成功率，降低了FEA使用门槛并提高了效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限元分析（FEA）存在学习曲线陡峭、关键仿真组件（如边界条件、载荷工况、求解变量）定义错误导致仿真失效等问题，通常需要多年工程经验才能解决实际问题。现有方法缺乏将自然语言直接转化为可执行FEA分析的能力。

Method: 提出AbaqusAgent多智能体框架，包含六个智能体：解释器（interpreter）、架构师（architect）、输入文件编写器（input writer）、运行器（runner）、审查器（reviewer）和可视化器（visualizer），覆盖标准FEA分析的前处理和后处理全步骤，利用LLM将用户自然语言指令转化为Abaqus可执行分析和结果可视化。

Result: 在50个多样化的固体力学问题上成功验证，整体成功率达到86%。代码已开源在GitHub。

Conclusion: AbaqusAgent不仅提高了固体力学FEA的效率并降低了计算力学教育的门槛，还推进了人-仿真交互范式，并可集成到AI驱动的优化和材料表征工作流中。

Abstract: Finite element analysis (FEA) is the most important numerical approach for solid mechanics. Challenges of FEA include a steep learning curve for entry-level users and potential false simulations due to incorrect definitions of key simulation components, such as boundary conditions, load cases, and solution variables. Years of engineering experience are usually necessary for real-world problem-solving. To address these issues, we present AbaqusAgent, a multi-agent framework grounded in large language models (LLMs) for solid mechanics analyses. AbaqusAgent is developed to facilitate analysis case generation and execution using Abaqus, one of the most widely used FEA packages, by turning users' natural-language instructions into executed FEA analyses and result visualization. AbaqusAgent is composed of six agents, including interpreter, architect, input writer, runner, reviewer, and visualizer agents, encompassing all the essential pre-processing and post-processing steps of standard FEA analyses. A wide variety of 50 solid mechanics problems have been successfully validated, achieving an overall success rate of 86%. Beyond improving the efficiency of FEA for solid mechanics problems and lowering the barrier to computational mechanics education, AbaqusAgent advances the human-simulation interaction paradigm and enables integration with AI-empowered optimization and material characterization workflows. The code is available at https://github.com/LIRAM-LIN/AbaqusAgent

</details>


### [329] [CAST: Non-Privileged Clipped Asymmetric Self-Teaching with Advantage Flipping for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00172)
*Yang Li,Gongle Xue,Yijia Guo,Yuheng Yuan,Liwen Hu,Lei Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CAST方法，一种无答案的自我蒸馏技术，用于改进GRPO风格的RLVR训练。CAST通过停止梯度的自我教师模型，根据轨迹正确性塑造token级优势，解决了GRPO中稀疏奖励和零方差组无梯度的问题。实验表明CAST能提升数学推理任务的RLVR训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等RLVR方法存在两个核心问题：1) 结果级奖励仅提供稀疏监督，且当所有采样轨迹全部正确或全部错误时，组相对优势失效（零方差）；2) 现有OPSD方法虽提供密集token级指导，但其token偏好不一定与轨迹正确性对齐，且需要特权教师上下文。本文旨在设计一种无需答案、与GRPO兼容的自我蒸馏方法，解决上述问题。

Method: 提出CAST方法，核心包括：1) 保留基于验证器的GRPO目标，但使用停止梯度自我教师模型（stop-gradient self-teacher）根据轨迹正确性塑造token级优势；2) 不需要参考解条件化的教师评分；3) 在整个训练过程中保持自我教师对数概率差活跃；4) 应用双向局部优势符号反转：正确轨迹中教师负token可获负token级优势，错误轨迹中教师正token可获有界正局部优势；5) 对零方差组（全正确/全错误）分配有界符号约束的基础优势，使其能贡献验证器签名的token反馈。

Result: 在数学推理任务上的实验表明，CAST能够改进RLVR训练效果，在保持轻量级、基于验证器的轨迹级目标的同时，提升了模型推理能力。

Conclusion: CAST是一种有效的无答案自我蒸馏方法，能够在不依赖特权教师上下文的情况下，通过token级优势塑造弥补GRPO的稀疏奖励和零方差问题，为RLVR训练提供更细粒度的监督信号。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has been widely used to improve reasoning in large language models. However, outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision, and group-relative advantages vanish when all sampled trajectories for a prompt are either correct or incorrect. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) offers dense token-level guidance, but its token preferences are not necessarily aligned with trajectory correctness; empirical diagnostics show that OPSD signals behave differently on correct and incorrect rollouts, with teacher-positive and teacher-negative gap signals exhibiting different noise profiles. These diagnostics are conducted under an OPSD-style privileged teacher context for analysis only, whereas CAST training uses answer-free self-teacher scoring.Motivated by these observations, this work proposes CAST, an answer-free self-distillation method for GRPO-style RLVR. CAST keeps the verifier-grounded GRPO objective, but uses a stop-gradient self-teacher to shape token-level advantages according to trajectory correctness. Unlike prior self-distilled RLVR methods, CAST does not require reference-solution-conditioned teacher scoring, keeps the self-teacher log-probability gap active throughout training, and applies bidirectional local advantage sign reversal: teacher-negative tokens in correct trajectories can receive negative token-level advantages, while teacher-positive tokens in incorrect trajectories can receive bounded positive local advantages. For zero-variance all-correct and all-wrong groups, CAST assigns bounded sign-constrained base advantages, so these otherwise zero-gradient groups can contribute verifier-signed token feedback. Experiments on mathematical reasoning show that CAST improves RLVR training while retaining a lightweight, verifier-grounded trajectory-level objective.

</details>


### [330] [TIGER: Traceable Inference with Graph-Based Evidence Routing for Mitigating Hallucinations in Multimodal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00232)
*Kaixiang Zhao,Tianrun Yu,Shawn Huang,Porter Jenkins,Yushun Dong,Amanda Hughes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TIGER是一个推理时修复框架，通过独立提取输入观测图和输出声明图，为每个声明分配基于图的风险分数，然后选择性修复高风险声明，从而在多模态生成中实现事实级修复，理论收敛分析和跨四种跨模态路径的实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时修复方法存在两个局限：一是输出中的幻觉性声明会偏置模型对输入的解释（因联合条件化设计），二是自由形式的反馈无法在事实级别进行排序和调度。

Method: TIGER独立从输入提取观测图、从当前输出提取声明图，为每个声明计算基于图条件的风险分数（基于支持和冲突），然后选择性地修复高风险声明，同时保持骨干网络冻结。

Result: 在图像→文本、图像+文本→文本、音频→文本、视频→文本四种跨模态路径上，TIGER有效减少了不支持的生成内容，同时保持了任务质量；在多个骨干网络上效果一致；CrisisFACTS案例表明该修复机制可在多源场景中改善接地性。

Conclusion: TIGER通过图条件化的声明级风险评分与局部修复策略，在理论上保证期望总风险几何收敛至显式渐近界，实证上在多种跨模态生成任务中有效减少幻觉。

Abstract: We study fact-level repair for multimodal generation, where a fluent output may contain specific facts that are not supported by the input. Existing inference-time repair methods often generate feedback by jointly conditioning on the input and the current output. This design has two limitations: hallucinated claims in the output can bias the model's interpretation of the input, and free-form feedback cannot be ranked or scheduled at the fact level. We present TIGER, an inference-time framework that redesigns feedback for localized repair. TIGER independently extracts an observation graph from the input and a claim graph from the current output, then assigns each claim a graph-conditioned risk score based on support and conflict. The model repairs selected high-risk claims while keeping the backbone frozen. We provide a convergence analysis showing that the expected total risk decreases geometrically to an explicit asymptotic bound under mild assumptions. Experiments across four cross-modal paths, including image-to-text, image+text-to-text, audio-to-text, and video-to-text, show that TIGER reduces unsupported content while preserving task quality. The gains hold across multiple backbones, and a CrisisFACTS case study suggests that the same repair mechanism can improve grounding in multi-source settings.

</details>


### [331] [MindZero: Learning Online Mental Reasoning With Zero Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00240)
*Shunchi Zhang,Jin Lu,Chuanyang Jin,Yichao Zhou,Zhining Zhang,Tianmin Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MindZero框架，通过自监督强化学习训练多模态大语言模型，实现高效且鲁棒的在线心智推理，无需显式心智状态标注，在准确率和效率上均优于基于模型的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI智能体在心智理论推理中面临三大挑战：(1)在线推理中多假设的鲁棒不确定性更新；(2)实时辅助所需的高效推理；(3)现实领域缺乏真实心智状态标注。需要一种无需标注、高效且鲁棒的在线心智推理方法。

Method: 提出MindZero框架，采用自监督强化学习训练多模态大语言模型。训练时，模型生成心智状态假设，由规划器评估其最大化观测行为似然的能力作为奖励信号，类似于基于模型的心智推理；训练后将基于模型的推理内化为快速的单次前向推理。

Result: 在gridworld和household领域的心智推理和AI辅助任务上，LLM单独不足；基于模型的方法准确率更高但速度慢、成本高且受限于骨干MLLM容量。MindZero显著提升了MLLM的内在心智推理能力，在准确率和效率上均优于基于模型的方法。

Conclusion: 心智推理可以作为一种自监督技能被有效学习，MindZero框架证明了通过强化学习将基于模型的推理内化到单次前向推理中的可行性和优越性。

Abstract: Effective real-world assistance requires AI agents with robust Theory of Mind (ToM): inferring human mental states from their behavior.
