Search algorithms which use external memory such as SSDs and HDDs with much higher capacity than RAM have been proposed in previous work, but previous work has focused on delayed duplicate detection approaches, as well as complex immediate duplicate detection (IDD) methods, and relatively simple methods for IDD have not been systematically studied. In addition, the effect of OS-level mechanisms for managing and speeding up accesses to external memory, such as page caches, has not been studied. This paper addresses these gaps in the literature by evaluating and analyzing the performance of simple baseline approaches for IDD-based A*.

</details>


### [441] [Does Compression Preserve Uncertainty? A Unified Benchmark for Quantized and Sparse LLMs via Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01850)
*Yujia Tong,Yuxi Wang,Yunyang Wan,Tian Zhang,Junhao Dong,Jingling Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了模型压缩（量化和剪枝）对大型语言模型不确定性量化能力的影响，发现压缩会解耦准确率与不确定性，且不确定性膨胀呈阈值性而非渐进性，表明仅用准确率评估压缩模型存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有压缩技术评估几乎只关注准确率保持，忽视了模型在安全关键应用中对自身不确定性进行可靠量化的能力，作者希望探究压缩是否破坏了这种能力。

Method: 对12种LLM在不同压缩配置下进行基准测试，覆盖5个NLP任务，使用共形预测（conformal prediction）提供严格的、无分布假设的不确定性度量。

Result: (I)压缩经常使准确率与不确定性解耦；(II)大模型比小模型更能吸收压缩带来的不确定性；(III)不确定性膨胀通常是阈值式的而非渐进的。

Conclusion: 仅用准确率评估不足以判断压缩后LLM的部署就绪度，不确定性感知的基准测试应成为模型压缩管线的标准组成部分。

Abstract: Model compression techniques such as quantization and pruning are widely used to reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), with existing evaluations focusing almost exclusively on accuracy preservation. However, in safety-critical applications, a model's ability to reliably quantify its own uncertainty is equally important. We ask: does compression preserve this ability? To answer this question, we benchmark 12 LLMs under various compression configurations across five NLP tasks, using conformal prediction to provide a rigorous, distribution-free measure of uncertainty. Our experiments reveal that: (I) compression frequently decouples accuracy from uncertainty; (II) larger models absorb compression-induced uncertainty far more effectively than smaller ones; and (III) uncertainty inflation is often threshold-like rather than gradual. These results suggest that accuracy-only evaluation is insufficient for assessing the deployment readiness of compressed LLMs, and that uncertainty-aware benchmarking should be a standard component of model compression pipelines.

</details>


### [442] [WorldCoder-Bench: Benchmarking Physically Grounded 3D World Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01869)
*Shuo Lu,Yinuo Xu,Kecheng Yu,Siru Jiang,Yongcan Yu,Yubin Wang,Haitao Yang,Yuxiang Zhang,Bin Wang,Ran He,Jian Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorldCoder-Bench 是一个用于评估大模型生成 Three.js 3D 世界能力的基准测试，包含 2,026 个专家任务，并提出 StateProbe 协议来验证运行时状态契约。最佳模型仅达到 27.8% 的验证覆盖率，失败主要由状态模式漂移和交互链断裂导致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Web 生成基准仅观察像素或 DOM 节点，无法评估 Three.js 世界中隐藏在 canvas 内的物理约束、空间关系和运行时状态同步等核心机制。

Method: 构建 2,026 个专家任务（分为仿真、渲染、应用三类），提供可选 .glb 资产和隐藏行为契约；提出 StateProbe 基于执行的协议，在沙盒浏览器中探测生成程序并通过变异加固的契约验证运行时状态和转换。

Result: 最佳系统（GPT-4o）在 WorldCoder-Core 上验证覆盖率 27.8%，在 WorldCoder-Robust 上 19.9%；失败主因是状态模式漂移和交互链断裂，而非缺少场景元素。便宜/快速模型在简单领域仍具价值。

Conclusion: 当前前沿模型在物理化 3D 世界生成任务上表现有限，亟需改进状态管理和交互一致性；WorldCoder-Bench 为评估该方向提供了标准化基准和协议。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked not only to write static interfaces, but to construct executable interactive worlds from natural language. Browser-native 3D, commonly built with Three.js, is a natural next frontier: generated programs must integrate assets, obey spatial and physical constraints, and keep user-facing controls synchronized with hidden runtime state. Existing web-generation benchmarks and evaluators, however, largely observe only pixels or DOM nodes, while the mechanics of a Three.js world unfold inside an opaque <canvas>. We introduce WorldCoder-Bench, a benchmark for autonomous, physically grounded 3D world synthesis. WorldCoder-Bench contains 2,026 expert-curated tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application scenarios, with optional .glb assets and hidden behavioral contracts. We further propose StateProbe, an execution-based protocol that probes generated programs in a sandboxed browser and verifies hidden, mutation-hardened contracts over runtime states and transitions. Beyond verification coverage, we report Return on Automation and Time Efficiency Multiplier to measure correctness-adjusted cost and time savings. Across nine frontier models, the best system reaches only 27.8% verification coverage on WorldCoder-Core and 19.9% on WorldCoder-Robust, with failures dominated by state-schema drift and broken interaction chains rather than missing scene elements. Utility metrics further show that cheap or fast models can still provide substantial value on easier domains. WorldCoder-Bench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WorldCoder-Bench/.

</details>


### [443] [EVA-Net: Subject-Independent EEG Motor Decoding with Video-Derived Motor Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01884)
*Ziyuan Li,Yueyu Sun,Yimeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EVA-Net两阶段框架，利用动作视频作为语义先验，通过跨模态对齐和知识蒸馏实现与主题无关的EEG运动解码，在公开数据集上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BCI系统中的EEG解码器因个体间差异和信号非平稳性导致跨主题泛化能力差；多模态方法使用文本作为语义锚点，但文本对动态运动过程的监督稀疏且静态，不足以解决这一问题。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用跨模态和监督对比学习对齐EEG与视频特征到共享空间，减少主体特异性变异；第二阶段通过视频类别原型和知识蒸馏将视频先验迁移至纯EEG分类器，不增加推理开销。

Result: 在两个公开数据集上实现强跨主体解码性能，在EEGMMI上LOSO准确率提升8.66%；消融实验表明视频作为语义锚点优于文本基线。

Conclusion: 动作视频作为语义先验能有效提升与主题无关的EEG运动解码性能，且优于文本基线，为实用化非侵入式BCI系统提供了新思路。

Abstract: Practical non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems require EEG decoders with strong cross-subject generalization and minimal calibration. However, inter-subject variability and signal non-stationarity often entangle motor semantics with subject-specific noise, limiting subject-independent decoding. Recent multimodal approaches use text as a semantic anchor, yet text provides sparse and static supervision for inherently dynamic motor processes. To address this issue, we propose EVA-Net, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding. In the first stage, EEG and video features are aligned in a shared space using cross-modal and supervised contrastive objectives to reduce subject-specific variation. In the second stage, video category prototypes and knowledge distillation transfer video-derived priors to an EEG-only classifier without adding inference overhead. Experiments on two public datasets show that EVA-Net achieves strong subject-independent decoding performance, including an 8.66% LOSO accuracy gain on EEGMMI. Ablation results further suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.

</details>


### [444] [Absorbing Complexity: An Interaction-Native Knowledge Harness for Financial LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01886)
*Ailiya Borjigin,Igor Stadnyk,Ben Bilski,Maksym Chikita,Dmytro Kyrylenko,Sofiia Pidturkina,Julia Stadnyk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出InKH架构，通过被动知识注入、时态图记忆、Wiki审计表面及带失效机制的背景提取，将金融LLM Agent的交互复杂性吸收到系统中。在46,080次评估中，InKH在900ms延迟下达到0.815的任务质量，相比Agent驱动的Wiki-Walk记忆，延迟降低82.95%，Token成本降低82.29%，过时知识使用减少96.58%，质量提升0.108，可追溯性提升0.461。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融AI Agent让用户承担了大量复杂性（重复表述目标、风险偏好、投资组合上下文等），导致延迟、重复错误、弱可审计性和不安全决策。因此需要一种将复杂性吸收到系统中的架构。

Method: InKH架构包含四个核心组件：(1) 被动知识注入（Passive Knowledge Injection）——在主模型步骤前组装有界工作上下文缓冲区；(2) 时态图记忆（Temporal Graph Memory）——支持低延迟检索；(3) Wiki审计表面（Wiki Audit Surface）——提供人类可读的治理信息；(4) 背景提取（Background Extraction）——包含成熟度、衰减和写入时失效机制。

Result: 在24个随机种子、4轮、每轮80个episode、6个基线的合成基准测试中（共46,080次评估），InKH达到0.815任务质量、900ms延迟。与Agent驱动的Wiki-Walk记忆相比，延迟降低82.95%，Token成本降低82.29%，过时知识使用减少96.58%，质量提升0.108，可追溯性提升0.461。与无失效机制的时态图系统相比，质量提升0.050，过时记忆使用减少96.58%，服务成本相当。

Conclusion: 金融AI的采纳发生在系统吸收复杂性而非转移给用户时。该基准验证的是架构级行为，而非实盘交易性能。InKH通过将上下文管理、记忆检索和知识失效系统化，有效解决了金融Agent的遗忘和上下文碎片化问题。

Abstract: Financial AI agents often fail for a simple reason: they make users carry the complexity. A user must repeatedly restate goals, risk preferences, portfolio context, past judgments, and shifting market assumptions, while the agent answers, retrieves, acts, and forgets. In finance, this is not just inconvenient. In tasks such as market analysis, copy-trading review, and trade preparation, forgotten context and stale memory can create latency, repeated errors, weak auditability, and unsafe decisions.
  We propose the interaction-native knowledge harness (InKH), an architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system. InKH converts user, market, portfolio, and tool events into structured operational knowledge. It uses passive knowledge injection to assemble a bounded working context buffer before the main model step, temporal graph memory for low-latency retrieval, a wiki audit surface for human-readable governance, and background extraction with maturity, decay, and write-time invalidation.
  We evaluate InKH on a reproducible controlled synthetic benchmark with 24 random seeds, 4 rounds, 80 episodes per round, and 6 baselines, producing 46,080 baseline-conditioned evaluations. InKH achieves mean task quality of 0.815 at 900 ms latency. Compared with agent-driven wiki-walk memory, it reduces latency by 82.95 percent, token cost by 82.29 percent, and stale-knowledge usage by 96.58 percent, while improving quality by 0.108 and traceability by 0.461. Compared with a temporal-graph system without invalidation, it improves quality by 0.050 and reduces stale-memory usage by 96.58 percent with comparable serving cost.
  The results support a design thesis for financial AI: adoption happens when complexity is absorbed by the system rather than transferred to the user. The benchmark validates architecture-level behavior, not live trading performance.

</details>


### [445] [Physically-Constrained Mamba-SDE for Remaining Useful Life Prediction under Irregular Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01894)
*Deyu Zhuang,Peiliang Gong,Yang Shao,Liyuan Shu,Qi Zhu,Xiaoli Li,Daoqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PC-MambaSDE框架，通过掩码感知连续Mamba编码器、物理引导的潜变量随机微分方程和终端退化惩罚，在不规则观测条件下实现准确的剩余使用寿命预测，并通过理论分析和实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RUL预测方法面临两大挑战：传感器观测数据的不规则性（异步采样、突发缺失、时间抖动）和纯数据驱动模型易生成违反不可逆损伤累积物理规律的退化轨迹。

Method: 1) 掩码感知连续Mamba编码器（利用观测掩码提取控制信号）；2) 物理引导的潜变量SDE（参数化校正混合漂移，叠加全局物理偏置强制单调退化）；3) 终端退化惩罚（将RUL预测转化为边界值问题，通过惩罚损失引导轨迹向故障状态演化）。理论上通过Girsanov定理证明变分目标等价于最小化KL散度，并通过Lyapunov分析保证学习动力学的全局渐近稳定性。

Result: 在公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PC-MambaSDE显著优于现有最先进方法，尤其在极端观测稀疏条件下表现突出，验证了将物理先验嵌入连续时间潜变量动力学的有效性。

Conclusion: PC-MambaSDE为工业不规则观测场景下的RUL预测提供了一种统一、鲁棒的连续时间框架，物理先验的引入有效提升了模型在数据不规则性和极端缺失条件下的预测性能。

Abstract: Accurate Remaining Useful Life prediction is critical for industrial predictive maintenance. However, real-world deployment is challenging due to the irregular nature of sensor observations, characterized by asynchronous sampling, burst missingness, and temporal jitter. Compounding this issue, purely data-driven models often generate physically implausible degradation trajectories that violate the irreversible nature of damage accumulation. To address this, we propose PC-MambaSDE, a unified continuous-time framework for robust RUL prediction under irregular observations. Specifically, we design a Mask-Aware Continuous Mamba Encoder that explicitly leverages observation masks to extract context-rich control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Physics-Guided Latent SDE with parametrically rectified hybrid drift, superimposing a global physical bias to enforce monotonic degradation even amid severe observation gaps. Additionally, we formulate RUL prediction as a boundary value problem via a Terminal Degradation Penalty, which decouples a Health Index dimension and applies a penalty loss to guide trajectories toward the failure state. Theoretically, we prove that our variational objective is mathematically equivalent to minimizing the KL divergence via Girsanov's theorem, and we guarantee the global asymptotic stability of the learned dynamics through Lyapunov analysis. To enable rigorous evaluation, we develop a Hybrid Irregularity Generation Scheme that simulates realistic industrial imperfections. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that PC-MambaSDE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under extreme observation scarcity, validating the efficacy of embedding physical priors into continuous-time latent dynamics.

</details>


### [446] [Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance: A Human-Centric Perspective on User-Generated Content Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01897)
*Tianjiao Li,Kai Zhao,Xiang Li,Yang Liu,Huyang Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出从传统信号指标向以人为中心的社会共鸣评估的范式转变，引入CASTER任务（基于多模态属性评估UGC社区共鸣）和MEDEA模型（通过Social-CoT机制模拟多视角观众认知与情感反应），并发布CASTER-Bench基准。MEDEA采用两阶段训练（监督微调+过程监督强化学习），在CASTER-Bench上显著优于现有方法，且推理路径可解释、符合真实社区反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统VQA仅关注美学保真度，忽视了UGC中复杂的社会动态。用户生成内容的质量本质上是社区共鸣的产物，而非单纯的信号保真度。因此需要从信号度量范式转向以人为本的共鸣评估。

Method: 提出MEDEA架构，核心创新是Social-CoT机制：与传统逻辑链式推理不同，Social-CoT进行多模态视角转换，实例化不同观众角色以模拟集体认知与情感反应（即"社区心智"）。训练采用两阶段：监督微调+过程监督强化学习，引入Social Alignment Reward确保推理路径扎根于真实社会认知。

Result: MEDEA在CASTER-Bench上显著优于SOTA基线，并提供可解释、共情的推理路径，与真实社区反馈高度一致。

Conclusion: VQA应从信号保真度转向社会共鸣评估；Social-CoT机制有效模拟社区心智；过程监督强化学习可提升社会认知对齐。该工作为UGC质量评估开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Traditional Video Quality Assessment (VQA) focuses narrowly on aesthetic fidelity, overlooking the complex social dynamics that define quality in User-Generated Content (UGC). In this work, we propose a paradigm shift from signal-centric metrics to human-centric resonance assessment. We introduce CASTER (Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance), a new task that evaluates whether a UGC item achieves positive community resonance based on its multimodal attributes rather than visual quality alone. To address this, we present MEDEA (Multimodal Engagement-Driven Evaluation Architecture), which introduces a novel Social Chain-of-Thought (Social-CoT) mechanism. Unlike traditional logical CoT, Social-CoT performs multimodal perspective-taking, instantiating diverse viewer personas to simulate collective cognitive and emotional reactions (i.e., the "community mind") before deriving a quality judgment. MEDEA is trained via a two-stage approach involving supervised fine-tuning and process-supervised reinforcement learning with Social Alignment Reward to ensure reasoning paths are grounded in authentic human social cognition. To support this task, we release CASTER-Bench, a comprehensive human-annotated benchmark covering diverse UGC categories. Experiments demonstrate that MEDEA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on CASTER-Bench while providing interpretable and empathetic reasoning paths that align with real community feedback.

</details>


### [447] [Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery from Multi-Annotator Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01906)
*Keito Inoshita,Takato Ueno*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯谱情感转换发现框架(BSETD)，通过多评分者软标签而非硬投票来建模对话中的情感转换结构，利用分层Dirichlet-Multinomial后验构建置信区间，再通过谱分解将转换矩阵分离为低频惯性分量与高频传染分量，在EmotionLines数据集上恢复了Plutchik和Russell两种情感空间的特征，并在跨语料验证中取得高相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情感转换研究通常通过多数投票将多评分者判断压缩为单个硬标签，丢弃了反映评分者不确定性的信号，无法准确理解逐轮对话中的情感转换结构。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 通过软标签的外积构建分层Dirichlet-Multinomial后验，为K×K转换矩阵的每个单元提供置信区间及BH-FDR控制的显著性；(2) 对对称图拉普拉斯进行谱分解，分离低频惯性分量与高频传染分量。

Result: 在EmotionLines上，Plutchik相邻的厌恶→愤怒(log2 lift +0.94)和愤怒→厌恶(+0.86)过度表达，Russell效价反转的快乐→愤怒(-0.90)和愤怒→快乐(-0.89)欠表达；五源跨语料验证显示英文内成对Pearson相关0.91-0.98，与中文M3ED间0.79-0.85，人类硬标签与LLM虚拟软标签间0.979。

Conclusion: 保留标注者不确定性的流程能够桥接情感动力学的计算研究与心理学理论，BSETD框架可有效从多评分者软标签中发现情感转换结构。

Abstract: Emotions evolve through the dynamics of conversation, and understanding their transition structure is foundational to applications ranging from mental-health screening to dialogue systems. However, existing studies typically compress multi-rater judgments into a single hard label by majority voting, discarding the uncertainty signal needed to understand turn-to-turn transitions. In this article, we propose Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery (BSETD), a two-stage framework that discovers emotion-transition structure from multi-rater soft labels. In the first stage, a hierarchical Dirichlet-Multinomial posterior is constructed through the outer product of soft labels, equipping each cell of the K x K transition matrix with a credible interval and Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) false discovery rate (FDR)-controlled significance. In the second stage, the symmetrized graph Laplacian is spectrally decomposed to separate a low-frequency (inertia) component from a high-frequency (contagion) component. On EmotionLines, BSETD simultaneously recovers the signatures of two distinct affective spaces: the Plutchik-adjacent transitions disgust to anger (log2 lift +0.94) and anger to disgust (+0.86) are over-represented, while the Russell-valence-reversed transitions joy to anger (-0.90) and anger to joy (-0.89) are under-represented. A five-source cross-corpus validation yields pairwise Pearson correlations in 0.91-0.98 within English, 0.79-0.85 against Chinese M3ED, and 0.979 between the human hard labels and the LLM virtual soft labels on the same utterance set, demonstrating that a pipeline preserving annotator uncertainty bridges the computational study of emotion dynamics with established psychological theory.

</details>


### [448] [SMH-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Environment-Grounded Reasoning and Action in Smart Homes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01912)
*Kuan Li,Shuo Zhang,Huacan Wang,Fangzhou Yu,Zecheng Sheng,Yi Gu,Weipeng Ming,Lei Xue,Chen Liu,Sen Hu,Ronghao Chen,Siyue Lin,Yuqing Hou,Xiaofeng Mou,Yi Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SMH-Bench是一个基于可执行模拟器HomeEnv构建的智能家居基准测试，包含1100个高质量任务，覆盖7大类22子类，用于评估LLM在复杂家庭环境中推理、交互和可靠执行的能力。实验发现前沿LLM在显式控制和查询任务上表现良好，但在自动化任务调度、歧义处理和个性化推理方面仍有明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能家居基准测试多聚焦于静态指令到API的映射或有限模拟，无法评估LLM在真实家庭场景中的推理、交互和可靠执行能力，因此需要更全面的评估基准。

Method: 构建了可执行可验证的智能家居模拟器HomeEnv，在此基础上设计SMH-Bench基准，包含1100个高质量任务，涵盖7大类22细分子类，并按简单、中等、复杂三种家庭环境（小型公寓到135个设备的密集多房间环境）进行分层评估。

Result: 前沿LLM在显式控制和查询任务上表现强劲，但在自动化任务调度、歧义处理和个性化推理方面存在显著弱点，且随着家庭复杂度增加性能下降明显。

Conclusion: SMH-Bench可促进更可靠、上下文感知且可实际部署的智能家居智能体的开发。

Abstract: Smart homes are evolving toward complex state-dependent living environments, requiring Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason over user intent, preferences, and multi-device interactions. However, existing smart-home benchmarks often focus on static instruction-to-API mapping or limited simulations, failing to evaluate whether LLMs can reason, interact, and act reliably in realistic household scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce SMH-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs in smart-home environments. Built upon HomeEnv, an executable and verifiable smart-home simulator, SMH-Bench contains 1,100 high-quality tasks spanning 7 categories and 22 fine-grained subcategories. It further stratifies tasks across simple, medium and complex homes, ranging from small apartments to dense multi-room environments with 135 devices. Experiments show that although frontier LLMs achieve strong performance on explicit control and query tasks, they still exhibit significant weaknesses in automation task scheduling, ambiguity handling and personalized reasoning, especially as home complexity increases. We hope SMH-Bench will facilitate the development of more reliable, context-aware, and practically deployable smart-home agents.

</details>


### [449] [VET: A Framework for Analyzing AI Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01929)
*Meredith Ringel Morris*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了VET框架（Valence-valence, Effectiveness-effectiveness, Trajectory-trajectory），用于对AI公众话语进行分类和批判分析，帮助识别AI炒作、AI末日、AI否认和AI常态四种极端立场，并作为AI素养工具支持公众"审查"两极化的AI讨论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统和社交媒体上关于AI的两极化言论威胁着公众AI素养的发展，需要一种系统化的方法来识别、比较和批判这些夸张叙事。

Method: 提出了VET框架，从效价（Valence）、有效性（Effectiveness）和轨迹（Trajectory）三个维度对AI话语进行分类，并用该框架分析四种典型立场：AI Hype、AI Doom、AI Denial和AI Normalcy。

Result: 展示了VET框架如何识别每种立场在夸大AI现状和/或可能演变方面的具体方式，并说明该框架可作为AI素养工具支持对极化话语的审查。

Conclusion: VET框架为识别、比较和批判两极化AI话语提供了系统化方法，有助于提升公众的AI素养。

Abstract: Public discourse on AI has become polarized; exaggerated positions on AI in traditional and social media threaten the development of AI Literacy among the general public. In this article, I introduce the VET Framework, a method for categorizing AI discourse along the dimensions of valence, effectiveness, and trajectory. I show how this framework can be used to identify, compare, and critique prevalent narratives of AI Hype, AI Doom, AI Denial, and AI Normalcy. Using VET, I analyze how each of these four stances exaggerates some aspects of the current state and/or likely evolution of AI, and illustrate how the VET framework can serve as an AI Literacy tool by supporting the ``vetting'' of polarized AI discourse.

</details>


### [450] [AutoMedBench: Towards Medical AutoResearch with Agentic AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01961)
*Junqi Liu,Salena Song,Yuhan Wang,Jiawei Mao,Hardy Chen,Xiaoke Huang,Tianhao Qi,Pengfei Guo,Yucheng Tang,Yufan He,Can Zhao,Andriy Myronenko,Dong Yang,Daguang Xu,Yuyin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoMedBench是一个面向自主医学AI研究工作流的workflow-aware基准测试，包含五个阶段（计划、设置、验证、推理、提交）和五个研究轨道，通过阶段级评分和错误分析揭示：验证阶段最弱，设置阶段最强，验证和提交失败是主要错误来源（分别占37.7%和38.1%），而任务理解错误仅占0.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学智能体基准主要评估最终输出，缺乏对研究过程中智能体行为的可见性，无法有效评估端到端医学AI研究流程中的智能体表现。

Method: 构建AutoMedBench基准，将医学AI研究流程统一为五阶段工作流（S1-S5：计划、设置、验证、推理、提交），覆盖分割、图像增强、VQA、报告生成、病灶检测五个研究轨道，设置Lite和Standard两个难度层级，采用最终任务性能与阶段级评分双重评估体系。

Result: 验证（Validate）是平均表现最弱的工作流阶段，而设置（Setup）最强；验证和提交失败分别占标记错误的37.7%和38.1%，任务理解错误仅占0.9%；出现一个错误代码的运行比无错误代码的运行平均总分低48%。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在使流程可执行（设置阶段）方面表现较好，但在验证可靠性方面存在明显不足，验证和提交流程是主要瓶颈；AutoMedBench的阶段级评估范式能够有效揭示智能体在研究过程中的具体行为弱点。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly expected to support end-to-end medical-AI research workflows, moving beyond isolated prediction tasks or short-form clinical question answering. However, existing medical agent benchmarks primarily evaluate final outputs, providing limited visibility into agent behavior within the research process. To address this gap, we present AutoMedBench, a workflow-aware benchmark for autonomous medical-AI research across diverse medical imaging and multimodal inference tasks, organizing agent execution into a unified five-stage workflow (S1-S5): Plan, Setup, Validate, Inference, and Submit. It comprises long-horizon tasks with each run averaging 33 agent turns, spanning five research tracks: segmentation, image enhancement, visual question answering (VQA), report generation, and lesion detection. Each task is evaluated under two difficulty tiers, Lite and Standard, which use the same data and metrics but differ in the amount of task-brief scaffolding, and each run is scored using both final task performance and S1-S5 stage scores, enabling stage-level analysis from the initial task brief to the final submitted artifact. Across thousands of recorded runs, stage-level scoring reveals that Validate is the weakest workflow stage on average, whereas Setup is the strongest, suggesting that current agents are better at making pipelines executable than at verifying their reliability. Post-run error analysis further shows that verification and submission failures dominate tagged errors, accounting for 37.7% and 38.1% of fired codes respectively, whereas task-understanding errors are rare at 0.9%, and runs with one fired error code have a 48% lower overall score than runs with no error code on average.

</details>


### [451] [Algorithmic algorithm development with LLMs: A Case Study on LLM-Usage for Contraction Order Optimization in Tensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01975)
*Fabian Hoppe,Melven Röhrig-Zöllner,Philipp Knechtges*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过张量网络缩并顺序优化的案例，研究了基于LLM的算法开发方法，重点关注LLM选择、评估指标和测试实例等设计选择。结果表明验证器引导的进化编码代理在算法开发/改进方面具有潜力，同时强调了人类科学家在评估、验证和解释方面的重要性及挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM在算法开发中的应用潜力，研究如何通过验证器引导的进化编码代理来改进算法，并评估不同设计选择（LLM类型、评估指标、测试实例）对算法开发效果的影响。

Method: 以张量网络缩并顺序优化为案例，使用OpenEvolve框架进行LLM-based算法开发，比较不同LLM选择、评估指标和测试实例的设计方案，采用验证器引导的进化编码代理方法。

Result: 验证器引导的进化编码代理在算法开发/改进方面展现出 promising 的效果；同时发现人类科学家在评估、验证和解释环节仍然发挥关键作用，且面临相应挑战。

Conclusion: LLM-based方法在算法开发中具有潜力，但人类科学家的监督和判断（评估、验证、解释）仍然不可或缺，算法开发不能完全自动化。

Abstract: We consider LLM-based algorithm development through a case study on contractionorder optimisation for tensor networks with OpenEvolve. We pay particular attention to the choice of the LLM as well as design choices such as evaluation metric and test instances. Our results highlight both the promise of verifier-guided evolutionary coding agents for algorithm development/improvement and the continuing importance of evaluation, validation, and interpretation -- and corresponding challenges -- by the human scientist.

</details>


### [452] [An NLP-Driven Framework for Curriculum-Labor Market Alignment: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction, ESCO-Anchored Semantic Matching, and Multi-Dimensional Gap Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01982)
*Sherzod Turaev,Mary John,Mamoun Awad,Nazar Zaki,Khaled Shuaib*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种四阶段NLP框架，结合大模型集成、SBERT语义对齐、双裁决协议和验证机制，从课程大纲中提取能力记录并与劳动力市场需求对齐，在阿联酋大学ABET认证计算机科学项目中验证了有效性，Cohen's kappa达0.79，并揭示了多个维度的供需缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从教育和劳动力市场语料库中进行信息提取的pipeline主要依赖词法-表层方法，无法恢复隐含能力、缺乏共享本体论支撑，且缺乏提取可靠性和文档级完整性的正式度量。

Method: 四阶段框架：(i) 基于JSON Schema约束的七槽能力形式化，使用双模型前沿大模型集成进行schema约束提示；(ii) 利用Sentence-BERT将提取记录对齐到ESCO v1.2.1受控词汇表的11个领域；(iii) 双层级裁决协议解决模型间分歧；(iv) 验证机制结合逐槽Cohen's kappa、schema一致性和文档级完整性审核。从85门课程的2025-2026学习计划中提取400条能力记录，与30个岗位的483条需求条款以0.50 SBERT余弦阈值进行对齐。

Result: 技能槽Cohen's kappa达0.79，100% schema一致性，100%文档级完整性。揭示了可解释的供需缺口：通识与横向技能缺口25.0%，算法与计算理论缺口13.8%，软件工程与项目管理缺口12.2%，人工智能与数据科学缺口仅1.8%（尽管供给覆盖率达38.6%）。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效从课程大纲中提取结构化的能力记录并与劳动力市场需求对齐，为高等教育质量保障中的课程-劳动力市场匹配提供了可靠的方法论基础。

Abstract: Schema-constrained information extraction from diverse educational and labor-market corpora remains an open challenge in natural language processing because existing pipelines rely primarily on lexical-surface methods that cannot recover implicit competencies, lack grounding in shared taxonomies, and provide no formal measures of extraction reliability or document-level completeness. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a four-stage NLP framework that combines (i) schema-constrained prompting of a two-model frontier-LLM ensemble against a JSON Schema-enforced seven-slot competency formalism, (ii) Sentence-BERT (SBERT) alignment of the extracted records against an eleven-domain ESCO v1.2.1 controlled vocabulary, (iii) a two-tier adjudication protocol that resolves inter-model disagreements, and (iv) a verification mechanism that combines per-slot Cohen's kappa, schema conformance, and document-level completeness audits. The framework is instantiated for a critical application in higher-education quality assurance, namely curriculum-labor market alignment for the ABET-accredited BSc Computer Science program at the United Arab Emirates University. The pipeline extracts 400 competency records from the 85-course 2025-2026 study plan and aligns them, under a five-scope analysis ranging from the computing core to a probability-weighted student trajectory, with 30 job postings (483 requirement clauses) at an SBERT cosine threshold of 0.50. The extractor achieves Cohen's kappa of 0.79 on the skill slot, with 100% schema conformance and 100% document-level completeness. The alignment surfaces interpretable supply-demand gaps of 25.0% in general and transversal skills, 13.8% in algorithms and computational theory, and 12.2% in software engineering and project management, with a near-zero 1.8% gap in artificial intelligence and data science despite 38.6% supply coverage.

</details>


### [453] [SafeMCP: Proactive Power Regulation for LLM Agent Defense via Environment-Grounded Look-Ahead Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01991)
*Lichao Wang,Zhaoxing Ren,Tianzhuo Yang,Jiaming Ji,Chi Harold Liu,Yaodong Yang,Juntao Dai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对LLM代理在MCP环境中因动作空间扩展导致的安全风险，提出SafeMCP服务端防御插件，通过世界模型的预测推理实现双层防御（主动工具过滤+即时干预），采用三阶段训练（环境动态对齐、安全策略初始化、双可验证奖励RL），在多个基准上实现安全与效用的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理通过MCP协议在复杂环境中扩展动作空间时，微小的误差或幻觉会被放大为灾难性故障，存在权力寻求风险，现有方法缺乏对工具获取过程的主动安全约束。

Method: 提出SafeMCP服务端防御插件：1）利用内部世界模型进行前瞻推理，实现双层防御（主动工具过滤+即时干预）；2）三阶段训练流程：环境动态对齐、安全策略初始化、双可验证奖励强化学习。

Result: 在PowerSeeking Bench、ToolEmu和AgentHarm基准上，SafeMCP在有效缓解风险的同时保持了代理的实用性，实现了安全均衡。

Conclusion: SafeMCP通过服务端的前瞻性推理防御机制，在不显著牺牲代理效用的情况下有效约束了LLM代理在MCP环境中的危险能力扩展，验证了世界模型引导的安全策略在代理安全中的有效性。

Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to operate in complex environments, the expansion of their action spaces offers agents unsafe capabilities and underscores the risk of power-seeking. While broad action space and greater environment influence are essential for task fulfillment, they create a fragile risk surface where minor errors or hallucinations are magnified into catastrophic failures. In response, we propose SafeMCP, a {server-side} defense plugin that constrains tool acquisition via predictive reasoning regarding future safety risks. SafeMCP utilizes an internal world model for look-ahead reasoning to implement a two-tier defense: proactive tool filtering to constrain hazardous power expansion and immediate intervention as a fail-safe. To train SafeMCP, we introduce a three-stage pipeline comprising environmental dynamic grounding, safe policy initialization, and reinforcement learning (RL) with dual verifiable rewards. Experiments on PowerSeeking Bench, ToolEmu, and AgentHarm show that SafeMCP achieves a safe equilibrium, effectively mitigating risks while preserving agent utility.

</details>


### [454] [Extreme Low-Bit Inference in Reasoning Models: Failure Modes and Targeted Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02011)
*Ekaterina Alimaskina,Darya Rudas,Denis Shveykin,Gleb Molodtsov,Pavel Vasiliev,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现2-bit量化会导致大推理模型（LRM）生成长度膨胀的推理轨迹（重复循环、预算耗尽、延迟提交等），从而抵消量化带来的速度优势。为此提出两种轻量级控制方法：FP16规划（提供高精度大纲）和循环救援（检测重复轨迹并回退或提交答案），在保持端到端速度的同时恢复模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型的长推理轨迹导致推理成本高昂，低比特量化虽能降低单token解码成本，但2-bit量化在极端下会因生成过程不稳定导致总token数膨胀，使得端到端加速效果失效。

Method: 1) FP16 Planning: 为2-bit模型提供一段简短的高精度推理大纲，引导后续低精度推理。2) Loop Rescue: 检测重复推理轨迹，要么提交早期答案，要么回退到FP16继续推理。两者均为轻量级、可插拔的控制策略。

Result: 在MATH-500上，Loop Rescue将Qwen3-8B的准确率从17.2%提升至74.2%；Planning+Loop Rescue将Qwen3-32B从65.0%提升至87.2%。证明了在轻量级检测和选择性FP16支持下，2-bit推理可以恢复精度并保持实际端到端加速。

Conclusion: 极端低比特推理的失败可被视为可控的生成病理问题，通过轻量级检测和选择性高精度干预，2-bit量化推理可以实现实际可用的精度-速度权衡。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on long reasoning traces, making inference expensive. While low-bit quantization reduces per-token decoding cost, we show that aggressive 2-bit inference can fail to deliver end-to-end speedup because instability in the generation process inflates total token count. Instead of merely lowering answer accuracy, 2-bit quantization often produces much longer traces with repetitive loops, budget exhaustion, delayed commitment, and unclosed reasoning segments. We analyze full reasoning traces of Qwen3 reasoning models across mathematical and commonsense benchmarks and show that accuracy degradation is tightly linked to these process-level failures. To address them, we introduce two lightweight controls: FP16 planning, which gives the 2-bit model a short high-precision outline, and loop rescue, which detects repetitive traces and either commits to an earlier answer or falls back to FP16. On MATH-500, loop rescue improves Qwen3-8B accuracy from 17.2% to 74.2%, while planning plus loop rescue improves Qwen3-32B from 65.0% to 87.2%. Overall, our results show that extreme low-bit reasoning becomes practical when its failures are treated as controllable generation pathologies: with lightweight detection and selective FP16 support, 2-bit inference can recover accuracy while preserving real end-to-end speed. Our code is available at: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/quantized-reasoning.

</details>


### [455] [RL-ACRGNet: Reinforcement Learning-Based Chest Radiology Report Generation Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02035)
*Yogesh Kumar Meena,Saurabh Agarwal,K. V. Arya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RL-ACRGNet，一种结合预训练DenseNet编码器与多级LSTM解码器的强化学习框架，在IU-Xray和MIMIC-CXR数据集上取得优于基线方法的报告生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动生成放射学报告耗时且存在解释不一致问题，现有深度学习模型在细粒度视觉特征捕捉和临床连贯性方面仍面临挑战。

Method: 构建编码器-解码器架构，采用预训练DenseNet作为编码器提取视觉特征，多级LSTM作为解码器生成文本；引入离策略强化学习框架，通过双网络结构和基于度量的奖励机制优化视觉-语义嵌入。

Result: 在IU-Xray数据集上，BLEU-4提升0.47%、METEOR提升0.17%、ROUGE-L提升0.518；在MIMIC-CXR数据集上验证了模型的鲁棒泛化能力。

Conclusion: RL-ACRGNet能有效生成高质量、临床相关的放射学报告，并在大规模数据集上展现良好的泛化性能。

Abstract: Medical imaging interpretation is a foundational pillar of modern clinical diagnostics, yet the manual generation of radiology reports remains a time-consuming process prone to interpretation inconsistencies. Within the field of medical AI, automating these descriptions through deep learning promises to streamline clinical workflows and standardise diagnostic output. However, accurate disease detection and precise report generation remain significant challenges due to limitations in capturing fine-grained visual features and ensuring clinical coherence. To address these issues, we propose RL-ACRGNet, an improved encoder-decoder model that integrates a pre-trained DenseNet encoder with a multilevel LSTM decoder within an off-policy reinforcement learning framework. Using a dual-network approach to refine visual-semantic embeddings through a metric-based reward mechanism, we demonstrate that RL-ACRGNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the IU-Xray dataset, achieving quantitative improvements in BLEU-4 (0.47%), METEOR (0.17%) and ROUGE-L (0.518). Furthermore, comprehensive evaluations on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR data set confirm the robust generalisation of the model and its ability to generate high-quality, clinically relevant reports

</details>


### [456] [Topological texture analysis of microscopy images of dynamic casein gelation and its relation to rheological properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02048)
*Zahra Tabatabaei,Diana Soto Aguilar,Jose C. Bonilla,Mathias P. Clausen,Jon Sporring*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成拓扑数据分析(TDA)、差分盒计数(DBC)、多重分形划分(MFP)和局部二进制模式(LBP)的计算工具箱，用于分析酪蛋白酸钠凝胶化的STED超分辨显微图像，成功捕捉了从分散聚集到网络渗透再到凝胶后重排的微观结构拓扑转变，超越了传统流变学提供的宏观平均响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流变学只能提供平均化的宏观力学响应，无法解析凝胶化过程中微观结构的细微转变。需要一种能够定量表征复杂微观结构动态演化的计算工具。

Method: 集成TDA（通过max-Betti-1曲线追踪拓扑环）、DBC、MFP和LBP四种计算方法，应用于GDL诱导酪蛋白酸钠凝胶化的STED时间序列超分辨显微图像（两种温度30°C/40°C和两种GDL浓度1.8%/3.5% w/v），并在模拟分形图像上验证。

Result: TDA的max-Betti-1曲线揭示了三个阶段：分散聚集的滞后期、与网络渗透和溶胶-凝胶转变对应的急剧衰减期、以及反映网络重组的凝胶化后增长期。DBC和MFP验证了这些拓扑转变，解析了结构复杂性和空间异质性的变化。

Conclusion: 该集成工具箱为表征食品与材料科学中具有动态微观结构演变的复杂体系提供了稳健的定量工具，能够检测到传统流变学无法分辨的微观结构转变。

Abstract: We propose a novel computational toolbox that integrates Topological Data Analysis (TDA), Differential Box Counting (DBC), Multifractal Partition (MFP), and Local Binary Patterns (LBP), applied to time-lapse super-resolution STED microscopy images of sodium caseinate gelation induced by glucono-delta-lactone (GDL) at 30 °C and 40 °C and two GDL concentrations (1.8% and 3.5% w/v).
  TDA tracked topological loops, closed ring-like structures reflecting protein network interconnectivity, via max-Betti-1 curves, which revealed a lag phase of dispersed aggregates, a sharp decay coinciding with network percolation and the rheologically observed sol-gel transition, and a post-gelation increase corresponding to network rearrangements. These topological transitions were corroborated by DBC and MFP as these methods were able to resolve changes in structural complexity and spatial heterogeneity. The toolbox was validated on simulated fractal images prior to experimental application. Together, these descriptors provided sensitivity to subtle microstructural transitions that bulk rheology captured as averaged bulk mechanical responses. This integrated approach provides a robust quantitative tool for characterizing complex microstructure in food and material science with evolving microstructural dynamics. Code is available at https://github.com/Zahratabatabaei/Delifood_CV_paper.git

</details>


### [457] [Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02049)
*Hallah Shahid Butt,Qiong Huang,Gökhan Demirel,Kevin Förderer,Erfan Tajalli-Ardekani,Simnon Waczowicz,Luigi Spatafora,Veit Hagenmeyer,Benjamin Schäfer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释深度强化学习（XRL）框架，应用于住宅建筑能源管理。通过对比在线策略与离线策略DRL智能体，发现A2C和PPO等在线策略算法在累积奖励和策略稳定性上优于离线方法。结合事后解释技术，该框架不仅通过最优电池管理降低电费，还提供了透明、可操作的决策过程洞察。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源（光伏、储能系统）的广泛集成使建筑能源系统日益复杂（发电波动、电价变化、实体增多），传统控制方法难以应对。深度强化学习虽能优化建筑运行，但其黑箱特性阻碍了用户信任和实际部署，亟需可解释的解决方案。

Method: 构建了包含实时测量值（需求、光伏发电、电池功率与荷电状态）、外部信号（动态电价、本地天气）、日历与节假日指示器以及需求与电价预测的扩展状态空间。训练并对比了A2C、PPO（在线策略）与离线策略DRL智能体，采用事后解释技术（post-hoc interpretation）对学习到的控制策略进行可解释性分析。实验基于合成数据及KIT Living Lab Energy Campus (LLEC)真实数据。

Result: 在线策略算法（A2C、PPO）在累积奖励和策略稳定性方面显著优于离线策略方法。XRL框架能通过最优电池管理降低电费，且事后解释技术成功揭示了智能体的决策逻辑，提供了透明、可操作的见解。

Conclusion: 可解释深度强化学习框架能有效解决建筑能源管理中DRL的黑箱问题，在保持优化性能的同时提升模型透明度与用户信任度，有助于推动数据驱动控制在实际能源系统中的实用化部署。

Abstract: The increasing integration of renewable energy sources into power systems, particularly in buildings equipped with photovoltaic (PV) panels and energy storage systems, introduces significant complexity in energy systems. Volatile power generation, varying electricity tariffs, and increased entities, e.g., PV systems, and heat pumps, have increased the complexity and made the system harder to operate. This leads to the demand for additional control and optimization routes including data-based controls, such as reinforcement learning. While deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as a promising solution to optimize building operations in dynamic and ever more complex environments, its black-box nature impedes user trust and practical adoption. This paper presents a framework for explainable deep reinforcement learning (XRL) applied to energy management in residential buildings. We demonstrate its usage on both synthetic data but also on real-world data from the Living Lab Energy Campus (LLEC) at KIT. We train and compare both on-policy and off-policy DRL agents on an expanded state space that incorporates real-time measurements (demand, PV generation, battery power, state of charge), external signals (dynamic electricity price, local weather data), calendrical and holiday indicators, and forecasts for demand and price. Our experimental results indicate that on-policy algorithms, particularly Advantage Actor Critic (A2C) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), outperform off-policy methods in terms of cumulative rewards and policy stability. To explain these models, we employ post-hoc interpretation techniques to elaborate the learned control policies. Our findings demonstrate that the XRL framework not only reduces electricity costs through optimal battery management, but also provides transparent, actionable insights into the agent's decision-making process.

</details>


### [458] [eMoT: evolving Memory-of-Thought via Symbolic Anchoring and Memory Corrosion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02054)
*Xiang Li,Jiwei Wei,Ke Liu,Yitong Qin,Jinyu Guo,Malu Zhang,Peng Wang,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出eMoT（演化记忆思维框架），通过将推理轨迹视为动态演化的记忆而非静态模板，结合记忆腐蚀机制、符号锚定引擎和一致性驱动精炼过程，有效解决了大语言模型在多步推理中的幻觉和数值计算问题。在多个推理基准上，eMoT显著提升了准确率和推理一致性，在Game of 24任务上达到100%准确率，且性能提升主要源于框架本身的推理控制而非模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在多步推理任务中存在幻觉和数值计算能力薄弱等关键局限，根本原因在于标准模型将推理视为一次性生成过程，而非保留和精炼成功的程序化逻辑。

Method: eMoT框架包含三个核心模块：(i) 记忆腐蚀机制——强化高效用推理结构同时逐步衰减低频结构；(ii) 符号锚定引擎——利用Python进行确定性计算，类比人类使用计算器；(iii) 一致性驱动精炼过程——将神经推理与符号输出对齐，减少逻辑偏差累积。

Result: 在Game of 24任务上达到100%准确率，超越基线最高17.6%；在GSM8K、ASDiv、SVAMP、MGSM等数学推理基准上均取得一致性提升；使用轻量级骨干模型即可获得优于依赖大规模模型的方法的性能。

Conclusion: eMoT框架通过推理控制机制而非模型规模驱动性能提升，验证了将推理轨迹作为动态记忆进行管理的有效性，为提升LLM多步推理的稳定性和可靠性提供了新范式。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance on multi-step reasoning tasks, their reliability is persistently hindered by critical limitations such as unconstrained hallucinations and poor numerical computation. Fundamentally, these issues arise because standard models treat reasoning as a transient, one-off generation process rather than retaining and refining successful procedural logic. To address these challenges, we propose eMoT (evolving Memory-of-Thought), a unified framework that stabilizes multi-step reasoning by treating reasoning trajectories as dynamic, evolving memories rather than static templates. The framework primarily consists of three interconnected modules: (i) a memory corrosion mechanism that reinforces high-utility reasoning structures while gradually decaying less frequent ones; (ii) a symbolic anchoring engine that utilizes Python for deterministic computation, much like a human uses a calculator; and (iii) a consistency-driven refinement process that aligns neural inference with symbolic outcomes, reducing the accumulation of logical discrepancies. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, eMoT improves accuracy and solution consistency over standard Chain-of-Thought and structured reasoning baselines.On the traditional task Game of 24, eMoT achieves 100% accuracy, surpassing the baseline by up to 17.6%. Evaluations on mathematical task GSM8K, ASDiv, SVAMP, and MGSM further show consistent gains in multi-step mathematical reasoning. In our evaluation, we achieve superior performance despite utilizing a lightweight backbone model with constrained baseline capabilities. Compared to alternative methods that rely on massively scaled models, our results demonstrate that the performance gains are fundamentally driven by the eMoT framework's reasoning control rather than sheer model size.

</details>


### [459] [Where Do Deep-Research Agents Go Wrong? Span-Level Error Localization in Agent Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02060)
*Jiaming Wang,Ziteng Feng,Jiangtao Wu,Ruihao Li,Qianqian Xie,Yuxiang Ren,He Zhu,Xueming Han,Fanyu Meng,Junlan Feng,Jiaheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度研究型智能体的轨迹级错误定位问题，构建了TELBench基准数据集，并提出了DRIFT审计框架，通过追踪智能体声明并验证其证据支持，将跨度级错误定位和首错误准确率提升高达30个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估仅关注最终答案的正确性，无法揭示轨迹中哪些部分导致答案不可靠，缺乏对深度研究型智能体过程级可靠性的细粒度分析。

Method: 收集2,790条真实轨迹，通过LLM辅助专家审查标注有害错误跨度，构建TELBench基准；提出DRIFT框架，以声明为中心追踪智能体输出，检查轨迹证据中的支持情况，标记无支持或冲突声明所在的跨度。

Result: DRIFT在多个模型家族和审计框架下，将跨度级错误定位和首错误准确率提升高达30个百分点。

Conclusion: 本文为深度研究型智能体的过程级可靠性评估提供了新视角，证明了声明级证据审计对于识别轨迹中关键错误的有效性。

Abstract: Deep-research agents solve tasks through long trajectories of search, tool use, evidence inspection, and answer synthesis. Evaluation based on final answers shows whether an agent succeeds, but not which parts of the trajectory make the answer unreliable. We study span-level error localization for deep-research agents. We collect 2,790 real trajectories from two agent frameworks, three backbone models, and three benchmarks, convert raw logs into semantic spans, and annotate harmful error spans through LLM-assisted expert review. From these annotations, we build TELBench, a 1,000-instance benchmark for identifying error spans among normal exploration, failed searches, tentative hypotheses, and harmless noise. We further propose DRIFT, a claim-centric auditing framework that tracks agent claims, checks their support in trajectory evidence, and marks spans where unsupported or conflicting claims affect the answer path. Experiments across model families and auditing frameworks show that DRIFT improves span-level error localization and first-error accuracy by up to 30 percentage points. Our work provides a process-level view of reliability in deep-research agents.

</details>


### [460] [BADGER: Bridging Agentic and Deterministic Evaluation for Generative Enterprise Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02109)
*Shannon Serrao,Soumitra Chatterjee,Dorina Strori,Abhishek Sharma,Nathan Miller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BADGER是Merkle提出的统一评估框架，整合了text-to-SQL评估与智能体行为评估，包含LLM辅助的SQL组件提取、混合执行准确率指标（Hybrid-EX，在150条人工标注工业查询上达到Cohen's kappa=0.717）以及企业智能体评估套件，可在客户受控数据环境中运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学术基准（Spider、BIRD等）和LLM评估方法（G-Eval、RAGAS）无法满足企业级AI系统将NL转SQL与多步智能体推理相结合的需求，缺乏统一的生产级评估框架。

Method: 1) LLM辅助的SQL组件提取，扩展Spider方法以处理CTE密集和方言特定SQL；2) Hybrid-EX混合执行准确率指标，先用LLM推断结构对齐再进行确定性单元格评分，解决列别名和数值容差问题；3) 企业智能体评估套件，整合RAGAS、G-Eval和智能体基准指标，新增Excess Tool Usage指标。

Result: Hybrid-EX在150条人工标注工业查询上：Cohen's kappa=0.717 [95% CI: 0.600-0.822]（高度一致性），平衡准确率87.3%，优于所有六个对比框架（Delta-kappa: 0.322-0.502, 均p<=0.001）。

Conclusion: BADGER作为持续评估基础设施而非一次性质量门禁，可在客户受控数据环境中运行，支持可配置的LLM评判后端和快速原型化定制指标。

Abstract: Enterprise AI systems that translate natural language into SQL queries and orchestrate multi-step agentic reasoning pipelines require evaluation approaches fundamentally different from academic benchmarks. Spider and BIRD established execution-accuracy protocols; G-Eval and RAGAS advanced LLM-based assessment; and recent work such as Spider 2.0, BEAVER, and BIRD-Interact has begun to address enterprise and agentic dimensions. No single framework unifies text-to-SQL assessment with agentic behavior evaluation into a production-grade pipeline calibrated against human expert judgment.
  We present BADGER, developed at Merkle, a unified evaluation framework integrating text-to-SQL assessment with agentic behavior evaluation. BADGER offers three contributions. First, LLM-assisted SQL component extraction extending Spider methodology to handle CTE-heavy, dialect-specific SQL. Second, a hybrid execution accuracy metric (Hybrid-EX) resolving column-aliasing and numeric-tolerance brittleness by using an LLM to infer structural alignments before deterministic cell-level scoring. Validated on 150 human-annotated industry queries, Hybrid-EX achieves Cohen's kappa=0.717 [95% CI: 0.600-0.822] (Substantial agreement) and 87.3% balanced accuracy, outperforming all six competing frameworks (Delta-kappa: 0.322-0.502, all p<=0.001). Third, an enterprise agentic evaluation suite assembling RAGAS, G-Eval, and agent benchmark metrics into a unified pipeline; Excess Tool Usage is the sole novel element.
  BADGER runs entirely within the client's governed data environment, supports configurable LLM judge backends, and enables rapid prototyping of client-specific judges and metrics, serving as a continuous evaluation backbone rather than a one-time quality gate.

</details>


### [461] [Learning When Not to Act: Mitigating Tool Abuse in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02132)
*Liuji Chen,Dianxing Tang,Xing Shi,Dingshuo Chen,Qiang Liu,Shu Wu,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EAPO是一种高效智能体策略优化框架，通过引入无工具轨迹、难度感知奖励塑造和置信度感知token重加权，让模型学会选择性使用工具，在9个推理基准上平均性能提升7-10%，同时工具调用减少18-24%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（统一工具使用惩罚或硬限制）虽能降低工具使用频率，但也会抑制有用的工具辅助探索，无法实现选择性工具使用。

Method: (1) 在每个rollout组中引入无工具轨迹；(2) 难度感知奖励塑造，对简单查询中冗余工具调用施加惩罚；(3) 置信度感知token重加权，改进策略学习。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B上，相比GRPO，平均性能分别提升10.45%、7.27%和9.69%，工具调用分别减少18.33%、18.33%和24.59%。

Conclusion: 智能体可以学会在何时不使用工具，而不损害工具集成的推理能力。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning can induce tool abuse, where models overuse external tools even for queries solvable by internal reasoning. Existing approaches mitigate this issue with uniform tool-use penalties or hard limits, which reduce tool frequency but may also suppress useful tool-assisted exploration. We propose EAPO, an Efficient Agentic Policy Optimization framework that learns selective tool use. EAPO introduces tool-free trajectories into each rollout group, applies difficulty-aware reward shaping to penalize redundant tool calls mainly on easier queries, and uses confidence-aware token reweighting to improve policy learning. Across nine mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, EAPO consistently improves the accuracy efficiency trade-off on Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Llama3.1-8B. Compared with GRPO, EAPO improves average performance by 10.45%, 7.27%, and 9.69%, while reducing average tool calls by 18.33%, 18.33%, and 24.59%, respectively. These results show that agents can learn when not to use tools without compromising tool-integrated reasoning.

</details>


### [462] [S3TS: Stochastic Scenario-Structured Tree Search for Advanced Planning Under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02151)
*Fabio Pavirani,Bert Claessens,Pierre Pinson,Chris Develder*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为S3TS（随机场景结构化树搜索）的算法，该算法结合了场景树（处理不确定性）和树搜索（处理非线性），能够在能源调度中同时应对模型非线性和不确定性两大挑战。在模拟比利时不平衡结算机制的需求响应场景中，S3TS在线性可解析场景下接近最优（成本偏差14%以内），在高度非线性场景下成本比短视算法降低51%，比确定性MCTS降低5.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有能源调度方法中，蒙特卡洛树搜索等可以处理非线性但无法显式建模不确定性，而随机数学优化等方法可以处理不确定性但难以集成非线性模型；缺乏能同时应对这两大挑战的规划技术。

Method: 提出S3TS（Stochastic Scenario-Structured Tree Search）算法，通过场景树显式表示不确定性，同时允许集成先进的非线性系统模型，将随机规划与树搜索相结合。

Result: 在线性可解析场景下，S3TS成本与数学最优解偏差在14%以内；在高度非线性场景下，相比短视算法成本降低51%，相比确定性MCTS成本降低5.4%。

Conclusion: S3TS有效填补了现有方法在处理非线性和不确定性双重挑战方面的空白，为能源调度提供了一种兼顾两者且性能优越的规划策略。

Abstract: Effective scheduling in the energy sector is essential to ensure the reliable operation of electrical grids and their connected assets by, for instance, optimizing the dispatch of generation units and storage systems. An effective planning strategy must (a) accommodate advanced and potentially non-linear system models -- exploiting the increasing data availability of modern grids, and (b) explicitly handle uncertainties arising, for instance, from the integration of renewable energy sources. While existing approaches can address either non-linearity (e.g., Monte Carlo Tree Search) or uncertainty (e.g., stochastic mathematical optimization), there is a lack of planning techniques capable of addressing both challenges simultaneously. To bridge this gap, we propose a Stochastic Scenario-Structured Tree Search (S3TS) algorithm that explicitly represents uncertainty through scenario trees while enabling the integration of advanced non-linear models. We evaluate S3TS on a simulated demand response signal publication problem, largely mimicking the imbalance settlement mechanism in Belgium. The results demonstrate near-optimal performance in linear, analytically tractable settings, with costs within 14% of the mathematically optimal solution conditioned to the scenario trees. In highly non-linear scenarios, S3TS significantly outperforms baseline methods, achieving cost reductions of up to 51% and 5.4% compared to a myopic algorithm and deterministic MCTS, respectively.

</details>


### [463] [An Abstract Worlds Semantic Framework for Belief Change Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02163)
*Daniel Grimaldi,M. Vanina Martinez,Ricardo O. Rodriguez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为抽象世界语义（AWS）的集合论信念变更框架，以世界为原始元素定义世界收缩和世界修正算子，统一了经典与非优先信念变更模型，并在经典命题逻辑下为AGM、KM及多重变更模型提供了同质化解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的信念变更理论（如AGM、KM、多重变更）在语法和语义层面缺乏统一的数学框架，不同模型间的结构关系不够清晰，且非优先信念变更与经典模型之间存在割裂。作者希望构建一个不依赖于逻辑语法的纯语义框架，以实现对各种信念变更模型的统一分析。

Method: 受Grove (1988) 的工作启发，将"可能世界"作为原始元素，在其上定义世界收缩（world contraction）和世界修正（world revision）算子；通过设计通用算子，统一经典（优先化的）与非优先的信念变更构造；在经典命题逻辑设定下，将AGM、KM及多重变更模型纳入同一语义框架。

Result: 成功构建了抽象世界语义框架，证明了该框架能够同质化地涵盖AGM、KM和多重变更模型；统一了优先与非优先信念变更；简化并泛化了基于信念集的信念变更理论体系。

Conclusion: AWS为信念变更理论提供了一种系统化的语义基础，通过将世界视为原语并定义通用算子，实现了理论框架的简化和泛化，有助于更清晰地理解不同信念变更模型之间的内在联系。

Abstract: This article proposes a set-theoretic framework for belief change, called Abstract Worlds Semantics, in which no logical syntax is assumed. Inspired by Grove's (1988) results, our approach treats worlds as primitive elements, over which world contraction and world revision operators are defined. This semantic framework enables a unified analysis of belief change models. Within this framework, we unify classical and non-prioritized belief change constructions by defining versatile operators. When classical propositional logic is considered, our framework provides a homogeneous account of AGM, KM, and Multiple Change models. In summary, AWS systematizes belief change frameworks and operators, simplifying and generalizing belief change theory over belief sets.

</details>


### [464] [From Capability Models to Automated Planning: An AAS-Native Approach for Automatic PDDL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02167)
*Hamied Nabizada,Thomas Wirt,Luis Miguel Vieira da Silva,Felix Gehlhoff,Alexander Fay*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种方法，能够从基于资产管理壳（AAS）的能力模型中自动生成完整的PDDL规划问题，无需工程师掌握PDDL语法或规划概念。该方法利用四项工业4.0标准（VDI 3682、IEC 61360-1、IDTA 02011、IDTA 02016）对AAS能力模型进行结构化描述，并通过提取算法将分布式多AAS架构转换为PDDL规划问题。在实验室生产系统上的验证表明，该方法支持通过修改AAS模型并重新生成规划域来系统性地探索布局设计权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产系统工程师需要验证给定布局是否支持所有必要的生产序列，但自动化规划技术所需的PDDL公式化表达要求专业知识，而生产工程师通常不具备这种专业知识。现有方法需要引入PDDL特定子模型，增加了使用门槛。

Method: 利用四项工业4.0标准（VDI 3682过程描述、IEC 61360-1语义属性限定、IDTA 02011类型层次、IDTA 02016实例描述）对AAS能力模型进行结构化建模，设计提取算法将分布式多AAS架构自动转换为完整的PDDL规划问题，所有规划元素均从资源功能的领域级描述（能力）中衍生。

Result: 在实验室生产系统的AAS模型上进行了验证，通过比较四种布局变体的最优规划结果，证明工程师可以通过修改AAS模型并重新生成规划域来系统性地探索设计权衡。

Conclusion: 该方法能够从工业4.0标准的AAS能力模型中自动生成完整PDDL规划问题，无需工程师掌握PDDL专业知识，为生产系统布局验证提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Engineers designing production systems need to verify that a given layout supports all required production sequences. Automated planning techniques can answer such questions, but formulating the required planning problems in the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) demands specialized expertise that production engineers typically lack. Asset Administration Shells (AAS) have emerged as the standardized Digital Twin for industrial assets in Industry 4.0. We show that AAS capability models, structured using four established Industry 4.0 standards (VDI 3682 for process descriptions, IEC 61360-1 for semantic property qualification, IDTA 02011 for type hierarchies, and IDTA 02016 for instance descriptions), contain sufficient information to generate complete PDDL problems automatically. Unlike prior work that introduced PDDL-specific submodels, our approach derives all planning elements from domain-level descriptions of resource functions, so-called capabilities, allowing engineers to model capabilities without any exposure to PDDL syntax or planning concepts. Our extraction algorithm transforms distributed Multi-AAS architectures into complete PDDL planning problems. We validate the approach on AAS models of a laboratory production system, comparing four layout variants using optimal planning to demonstrate how engineers can systematically explore design trade-offs by modifying the AAS model and regenerating the planning domain

</details>


### [465] [CEON: Circular Economy Ontology Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02253)
*Huanyu Li,Els de Vleeschauwer,Robin Keskisärkkä,Mikael Lindecrantz,Mina Abd Nikooie Pour,Ying Li,Ben De Meester,Patrick Lambrix,Eva Blomqvist*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了循环经济本体网络(CEON)，通过语义互操作性实现跨行业、跨产品生命周期的信息共享，以支持循环经济策略（如再利用、再制造、回收等），并在建筑、电子和纺织三个领域进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环经济涉及多个行业部门和产品生命周期，需要基础设施层面的信息共享和跨部门通信，但循环经济领域的知识表示仍面临挑战，缺乏跨领域的概念定义和语义感知数据文档化支持。

Method: 在Onto-DESIDE项目框架下开发了循环经济本体网络(CEON)，定义跨部门核心概念，实现语义互操作性，并通过建筑、电子和纺织三个行业的数据文档化场景进行验证。

Result: 成功构建了CEON本体网络，能够实现跨行业数据文档化，填补了循环经济领域本体表示的空白。

Conclusion: CEON本体网络通过语义互操作性有效支持了循环经济的信息共享需求，为跨行业循环经济数据文档化提供了可行的知识表示方案。

Abstract: Increasing the circularity of resource use in our society has been recognized as a path to sustainability, i.e., transitioning into a more circular economy. There are many different circular strategies to do so, such as reusing products and components, refurbishing and remanufacturing used products, or recycling left-over or used materials. To enable these strategies, it is necessary to share information at the infrastructure level and to communicate between industry sectors along the product life cycle. Enabling semantic interoperability in this information sharing and communication is therefore a key to increasing circularity. However, knowledge representation for the circular economy (CE) domain, which involves many relevant industry sectors related to product life cycles, remains challenging. To bridge this gap, we developed the Circular Economy Ontology Network (CEON) within the Onto-DESIDE project. This ontology network aims to fill gaps in CE by defining cross-sectorial concepts and to enable semantics-aware data documentation. We demonstrate CEON through cross-industry data documentation scenarios spanning construction, electronics, and textile sectors.

</details>


### [466] [POIROT: Interrogating Agents for Failure Detection in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02282)
*Iñaki Dellibarda Varela,R. Sendra-Arranz,Pablo Romero-Sorozabal,J. M. Valverde-García,Annemarie F. Laudanski,Álvaro Gutiérrez,Eduardo Rocon,Manuel Cebrian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: POIROT是一种利用多智能体系统自身智能体进行故障诊断的协议，通过利用架构中已有的认知多样性来检测和归因故障，无需外部中央评判器。实验表明其性能优于单LLM评估基线，且优势随问题复杂度、智能体数量和故障维度增加而扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统在安全关键领域部署面临两大障碍：一是涌现故障和幻觉难以表征，二是现有评估范式依赖集中式评判，导致单点故障且需要领域专业知识。新兴AI法规使得这一问题在法律上不可持续。

Method: 提出POIROT协议，将系统自身的智能体重用为诊断层，利用架构中已有的认知多样性进行故障检测和归因，无需外部化安全监督。

Result: POIROT在所有评估设置中均优于单LLM评估基线；增益随问题复杂度（OR=1.60, p=0.008）、智能体数量和故障维度增加而扩大，且在复合故障条件下保持有效性。

Conclusion: 安全监督无需外部化：执行角色的智能体拥有足够的集体智能来进行自我审计。同时开源了POIROT库和BLAME基准数据集。

Abstract: Orchestrating Large Language Models into Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS) has unlocked remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet emergent failures and hallucinations that resist characterisation block their deployment in safety-critical domains -- a gap made legally untenable by emerging AI regulation. Existing evaluation paradigms share a common flaw: centralised judgment creates single points of failure and demands domain-specific expertise. Here we present POIROT, a protocol that repurposes a system's own agents as its diagnostic layer, leveraging the epistemic diversity already present in the architecture. Across evaluated settings, POIROT outperforms single-LLM evaluator baselines, with gains that scale with problem complexity (OR = 1.60, $p = 0.008$), agent count, and fault dimensionality, persisting under compound fault conditions. These results demonstrate that safety oversight need not be externalised: the agents executing a role carry sufficient collective intelligence to audit it. We release POIROT as an open-source library alongside BLAME, a benchmark for fault attribution in safety-critical multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [467] [Repair Before Veto: Repair-Augmented Constraint Learning for Contextual Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02326)
*Yifan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出修复增强约束学习(RACL)框架，将已知修复操作提升为分类器语义的一部分，实现"先修复再否决"的决策范式，显著降低错误否决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有硬约束学习方法将违反约束的候选直接否决，修复过程在决策语义之外进行，无法利用已知的有限修复选项（如添加票务选项、更改配置等）在否决前进行修复。

Method: RACL构建上下文决策框架，将已知修复算子提升到分类器语义中。候选在可负担修复使其可行且足够偏好时才被接受，否则返回结构化拒绝信用及修复计划。

Result: 在DB1B衍生基准测试中最困难的数据层级上，验证集选择的RACL将错误否决降至10/4039（FVR=0.0025），而最强的修复搜索黑盒基线约为1064/4039，同时清晰展示了FVR/EDR权衡。

Conclusion: RACL严格泛化无修复HASSLE语义，揭示了终结否决规则存在不可约的错误否决间隙，将二元标签不可辨识性与决策规则可学习性分离，并在观测可行性共享权重设定下给出了容量和校准界。

Abstract: Hard constraints are usually treated as terminal vetoes: once a candidate violates a requirement, the learned rule rejects it and any repair is handled outside the decision semantics. This misses a common deployed regime in which the system already knows a finite menu of modifications, such as adding a ticket option, changing a configuration, or requesting an available service upgrade. Existing constraint-learning, soft-relaxation, and recourse methods address nearby problems, but they do not learn whether an option should be repaired before being vetoed. We introduce Repair-Augmented Constraint Learning (RACL), a contextual decision framework that lifts known repair operators into the classifier semantics. A candidate is accepted when an affordable repair makes it feasible and preferred enough; otherwise the system returns a structured rejection credit and, when applicable, a repair plan. This repair-before-veto view strictly generalizes no-repair HASSLE-style semantics, reveals an irreducible false-veto gap for terminal-veto rules, separates binary-label non-identifiability from decision-rule learnability, and gives capacity and calibration bounds for the observed-feasibility shared-weight setting. Across controlled and DB1B-derived benchmarks, RACL recovers the intended credit and repair structure. On the hardest raw-data-derived tier, validation-selected RACL reduces false vetoes to 10/4039 (FVR 0.0025), versus about 1064/4039 for the strongest repair-search black-box baseline, while making the FVR/EDR trade-off explicit.

</details>


### [468] [Forget Attention: Importance-Aware Attention Is All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02332)
*Soohyeong Shin,Yeongwook Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SISA（SSM通知的Softmax注意力），通过在注意力分数内部直接加入SSM导出的重要性项，实现分数级别的SSM-注意力融合，无需循环状态或自定义内核，在单一SDPA调用中完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合语言模型（如Jamba的块级、Hymba的头级）将注意力和SSM放在独立隔间中，彼此在注意力计算过程中互不通知，无法实现两者的深度协同。

Method: 在注意力分数内部直接加入SSM导出的重要性项，通过增强查询/键向量实现单一SDPA调用，无需循环状态或自定义内核。

Result: 152M/5B token下，LAMBADA贪婪17.3%（优于Transformer 13.9和Mamba-3 15.5），NIAH从第1K步即达100%，比Transformer的检索收敛快7倍；369M时Mamba-3领先LAMBADA，SISA保持完美NIAH和标准SDPA执行。

Conclusion: SISA定义了SSM-注意力混合的第三个设计轴——分数级融合，超越了已有的块级和头级范式。

Abstract: Combining attention's global retrieval with the sequential importance signal of state space models (SSMs) is the open challenge of hybrid language modeling. Transformers see everywhere but cannot prioritize; SSMs know what matters but cannot revisit. Existing hybrids -- Jamba (block level) and Hymba (head level) -- place the two in separate compartments, so neither informs the other during the attention computation itself. We propose SISA (SSM-Informed Softmax Attention), which adds an SSM-derived importance term directly inside the attention score and realizes the full operation as a single SDPA call on augmented query/key vectors -- no recurrent state, no custom kernel. At 152M / 5B tokens, SISA reaches LAMBADA-greedy 17.3% (vs. Transformer 13.9 and Mamba-3 15.5) and attains NIAH 100% from step 1K, 7x faster than Transformer's retrieval convergence; at 369M, Mamba-3 leads LAMBADA while SISA preserves perfect NIAH and stock-SDPA execution. SISA thus defines a third design axis for SSM-attention hybrids -- score-level fusion -- beyond the block-level and head-level paradigms that have dominated the field.

</details>


### [469] [Coordination Graphs for Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02337)
*Santiago Amaya-Corredor,Miguel Calvo-Fullana,Anders Jonsson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CG-CMARL通过将协调图与拉格朗日对偶性结合，提出了一种可扩展的约束多智能体强化学习框架，其学习模型数量与智能体数量无关，并通过Max-Sum消息传递协调动作，利用单一训练模型即可追踪帕累托前沿，在多达10个智能体的协作导航任务中优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束多智能体强化学习面临两个相互交织的挑战：联合动作空间随智能体数量指数增长，以及额外约束条件以奖励结构本身无法捕获的方式耦合智能体。现有方法难以同时解决可扩展性与约束处理问题。

Method: 将联合问题分解为成对区域，每个区域由一组共享Q函数（一个主目标、每个约束各一个）服务，使学习模型数量与智能体数量无关；执行时通过Max-Sum消息传递在因子图上协调动作，拉格朗日乘子控制目标-约束权衡，单一模型即可追踪帕累托前沿。

Result: 在协作导航任务（多达10个智能体）上，该方法生成的帕累托前沿优于固定奖励塑形比率的基线方法，且可扩展到集中式方法难以处理的团队规模。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了温和条件下的收敛保证和组合误差界（误差可分解为可解释的独立来源），证明了协调图与拉格朗日对偶结合能有效解决CMARL的可扩展性与约束耦合问题。

Abstract: Constrained Multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL) faces two intertwined challenges: the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of agents, and additional requirements couple agents in ways that reward structure alone does not capture. We introduce Coordination Graphs for Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CG-CMARL), a framework that addresses both challenges by combining coordination graphs with Lagrangian duality. The system decomposes the joint problem into pairwise regions, each served by a set of shared Q-functions, one for the primary objective and one for each of the constraints, so that the number of learned models is independent of the number of agents. At execution time, Max-Sum message passing coordinates actions across the factor graph, while a Lagrangian multiplier controls the objective--constraint tradeoff, allowing a single trained model to trace a Pareto front without retraining. We provide convergence guarantees under mild conditions, together with a compositional error bound that decomposes into separate interpretable sources, each traceable to a specific design choice and independently controllable. Experiments on cooperative navigation tasks (where teams of up to 10 agents must coordinate to reach target positions while satisfying pairwise constraints) show that our method produces Pareto fronts dominating established baselines trained at fixed reward-shaping ratios, while scaling to team sizes where centralized approaches become intractable.

</details>


### [470] [SIRI: Self-Internalizing Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Skills for LLM Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02355)
*Zhongyu He,Yuanfan Li,Fei Huang,Tianyu Chen,Siyuan Chen,Xingyang Li,Meng Hsuan Yu,Xiangrong Liu,Leyi Wei,Lu Pan,Ke Zeng,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SIRI提出三阶段框架（预热→自我技能挖掘→内化），使LLM智能体无需外部技能生成器或推理时技能库即可自主发现、验证并内化技能，在ALFWorld和WebShop上超越多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于技能的方法依赖外部技能生成器进行训练或推理时持续检索技能，增加了工程复杂度、上下文长度和部署延迟。亟需一种无需外部依赖、能自主内化技能的方法。

Method: 三阶段框架：1）用GiGPO预热策略获得基本交互能力并收集无技能轨迹；2）自我技能挖掘：策略从自身成功轨迹中总结紧凑技能，并通过配对实验（有/无技能）验证技能有效性；3）利用轨迹级效用和动作级优势将有益技能引导的动作蒸馏到纯策略中。推理时仅需原始提示。

Result: 在ALFWorld上GiGPO从0.908提升至0.930，WebShop上从0.728提升至0.813，超越基于提示、强化学习和记忆增强的基线。自我挖掘策略性能与闭源大模型蒸馏相当。

Conclusion: SIRI证明了LLM智能体可完全依赖自身能力发现并内化有用技能，无需外部技能库，降低了部署复杂度并提升了性能。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can benefit from reusable skills, yet existing skill-based methods often rely on external skill generators during training or persistent skill retrieval at inference, increasing engineering complexity, context length, and deployment latency. We propose Self-Internalizing Reinforcement learning with Intrinsic skills (SIRI), a three-phase framework that enables agents to discover, validate, and internalize skills without external skill generators or inference-time skill banks. SIRI first warms up the policy with GiGPO to acquire basic interaction ability and collect successful skill-free trajectories. It then performs self-skill mining, where the current policy summarizes compact skills from its own successful plain rollouts and validates them through paired skill-augmented and skill-free rollouts. Finally, SIRI distills only beneficial skill-guided action tokens into the plain policy using trajectory-level utility and action-level advantage. At inference, the agent runs with the original prompt only. On ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SIRI improves GiGPO from 0.908 to 0.930 on ALFWorld and from 0.728 to 0.813 on WebShop, outperforming prompt-based, RL-based, and memory-augmented baselines. Further analysis shows that our self-mining strategy can achieve performance comparable to distillation with closed-source large model. Our code is available at https://github.com/kirito618/SIRI.

</details>


### [471] [MOC: Multi-Order Communication in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02359)
*Yao Guan,Lin Wang,Zhihu Lu,Ziyi Wang,Wenzhu Yan,Qiang Duan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多阶通信（MOC）方案，通过重构智能体间通信以捕获多跳依赖关系，并设计语义-拓扑合并算法优化语义保真度，在多个数据集和不同规模的LLM骨干网络上一致提升了任务性能并降低了通信成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于LLM的多智能体系统大多聚焦于优化协调拓扑，而忽略了智能体间消息传输与优化的关键问题。现有方案通常直接拼接一阶邻居响应，导致证据感受野受限，关键信息在多跳路径中逐渐稀释。

Method: 提出多阶通信（MOC）方案：(1) 形式化通信机制，构建结构化的多阶证据流；(2) 设计语义-拓扑合并（Semantic-Topological Merging）算法，在token约束下优化语义保真度。

Result: 在六个不同数据集和不同参数规模的LLM骨干网络上，MOC一致提升了任务性能并降低了通信成本。

Conclusion: MOC通过重构多跳依赖关系和语义优化策略，有效解决了现有通信方案中证据感受野受限和信息稀释问题，验证了其在多智能体系统中提升效率与性能的有效性。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Systems, most research focuses on optimizing coordination topology while largely underexploring the equally critical problem: how to transmit and optimize messages among agents effectively? Current communication schemes typically rely on the direct concatenation of first-order neighbor responses, which induces a restricted evidence receptive field and leads to the dilution of crucial insights over multi-hop paths. To address these limitations, we propose the Multi-Order Communication (MOC) scheme, which reconstructs the inter-agent communication to capture multi-hop dependencies and incorporates a structural message consolidation strategy to ensure efficiency. Specifically, we formalize the communication mechanism to construct a structured multi-order evidence stream, and subsequently design a Semantic-Topological Merging algorithm to optimize semantic fidelity within token constraints. Extensive experiments across six diverse datasets and LLM backbones of varying parameter scales demonstrate that MOC consistently improves task performance and reduces communication costs. The code is available at https://github.com/yao-guan/MOC.

</details>


### [472] [COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02372)
*Youwei Liu,Jian Wang,Hanlin Wang,Wenjie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COMAP 提出了一种通过闭环交互共同演化文本世界模型与智能体策略的框架，使世界模型能自适应智能体不断变化的交互分布，并通过未来感知的反思机制提升决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本世界模型训练后固定，无法适应智能体策略演化导致的分布漂移；而智能体改进方法通常依赖外部奖励或验证器，限制了其在真实交互环境中的适用性。

Method: COMAP 框架包含两个核心组件：1) 世界模型为候选动作预测未来状态反馈，智能体通过估计反馈的可靠性进行未来感知反思，优化动作选择；2) 利用演化过程中的on-policy轨迹，通过自蒸馏方式持续更新世界模型，使其更好地匹配智能体当前的交互分布。

Result: 在具身任务规划、Web导航和工具使用等多个基准上，COMAP 一致优于竞争基线，例如使用Qwen3-4B时相对提升16.75%。进一步分析表明，共演化循环能随时间提高世界模型的预测精度，并促进更有效的长程决策。

Conclusion: COMAP 通过世界模型与智能体策略的共演化，有效解决了分布漂移问题，无需外部奖励即可持续提升决策能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Equipping language agents with world models enables them to anticipate environment dynamics and evaluate candidate actions before execution. However, existing textual world models are typically fixed after training, preventing them from adapting to the on-policy state-action distributions induced by an evolving agent. Meanwhile, agent-improvement methods often rely on external rewards or verifiers, limiting their applicability in realistic interactive environments. In this paper, we propose COMAP, a novel framework that co-evolves textual world models and agent policies through closed-loop interaction. At each decision step, the world model predicts future state feedback for candidate actions, and the agent performs future-aware reflection by estimating the reliability of this feedback and refining its action accordingly. The resulting on-policy trajectories are then used to update the world model via self-distillation, allowing it to better match the agent's evolving interaction distribution. Across embodied task planning, Web navigation, and tool-use benchmarks, COMAP consistently outperforms competitive baselines, e.g., +16.75% relative improvement with Qwen3-4B. Further analyses show that the co-evolutionary loop improves the world model's prediction accuracy over time and leads to more effective long-horizon decision-making. Our code is available at: https://github.com/loyiv/CoMAP.

</details>


### [473] [Harness-1: Reinforcement Learning for Search Agents with State-Externalizing Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02373)
*Pengcheng Jiang,Zhiyi Shi,Kelly Hong,Xueqiang Xu,Jiashuo Sun,Jimeng Sun,Hammad Bashir,Jiawei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Harness-1，一个20B参数大小的搜索智能体，通过在有状态搜索框架（harness）中进行强化学习训练。框架负责环境侧的工作记忆管理（候选池、重要度标记、证据链接、验证记录等），而策略仅保留语义决策（搜索什么、保留/丢弃哪些文档、何时验证、何时停止）。在8个检索基准上，Harness-1达到0.730平均策划召回率，超越下一代最强开放搜索智能体11.4个点，与更大规模的前沿模型搜索器竞争力相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有搜索智能体将搜索策略与状态管理（追踪已见证据、开放约束、已核实声明等）耦合在同一个策略中，导致强化学习需要同时优化语义搜索决策和本可由环境更可靠维护的常规簿记工作，增加了不必要的训练复杂度。

Method: 提出Harness-1（20B参数检索子智能体），在有状态搜索框架（harness）中训练。框架负责环境侧工作记忆：候选池、重要度标记的策展集、紧凑证据链接、验证记录、压缩去重观察结果、以及预算感知的上下文渲染。策略仅负责语义决策（搜索内容、文档保留/丢弃、验证时机、终止条件），通过强化学习优化。

Result: 在8个检索基准（涵盖网页、金融、专利、多跳问答）上，平均策划召回率0.730，比下一代最强开放搜索子智能体高11.4个百分点，与更大规模的前沿模型搜索器竞争力相当；在留出的迁移基准上表现尤为突出。

Conclusion: 将状态管理从策略中解耦到环境侧，使强化学习能更聚焦于语义搜索决策，从而训练出泛化能力更强的检索行为。

Abstract: Search agents are often trained as policies over growing transcripts: the model must decide how to search while also remembering what it has seen, which evidence is useful, which constraints remain open, and which claims have actually been checked. We argue that this formulation puts too much routine state management inside the policy: reinforcement learning is forced to optimize both semantic search decisions and recoverable bookkeeping that the environment can maintain more reliably. We introduce Harness-1, a 20B search agent (retrieval subagent) trained with reinforcement learning inside a stateful search harness. The harness maintains environment-side working memory, including a candidate pool, an importance-tagged curated set, compact evidence links, verification records, compressed and deduplicated observations, and budget-aware context rendering. The policy retains the semantic decisions: what to search, which documents to keep or discard, what to verify, and when to stop. Across eight retrieval benchmarks spanning web, finance, patents, and multi-hop QA, Harness-1 achieves 0.730 average curated recall, outperforming the next strongest open search subagent by +11.4 points and remaining competitive with much larger frontier-model searchers. Its gains are especially strong on held-out transfer benchmarks, suggesting that reinforcement learning over explicit search state can produce retrieval behaviors that generalize beyond the training domains. Our code is available at https://github.com/pat-jj/harness-1.

</details>


### [474] [Spatial Representation Learning Beyond Pixels: Unifying Raster Data and Vector Semantics for Human-Centric Geospatial Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02374)
*Steffen Knoblauch,Hao Li,Gengchen Mai,Konstantin Klemmer,Song Gao,WenWen Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文呼吁将地球观测基础模型从仅处理栅格数据扩展到联合学习栅格与矢量数据的统一空间表示，以构建更准确、可解释的下一代地理空间AI系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前地球观测基础模型仅局限于栅格模态，忽视了OpenStreetMap等矢量数据中丰富的结构化信息（几何、拓扑、语义关系），导致两种互补数据模态被孤立处理，依赖有损转换来桥接。

Method: 提出范式转变，倡导在统一嵌入空间中进行联合空间表示学习，融合基于栅格的感知与基于矢量的推理，利用多模态地理空间学习的最新进展来对齐异构空间数据源。

Result: 指出联合表示学习能够整合栅格数据（连续物理/光谱模式）和矢量数据（离散对象及其关系结构，尤其代表人类系统信息）的互补优势。

Conclusion: 实现栅格与矢量的联合学习是开发下一代地理空间AI的关键，能够实现对地球更准确、可解释、语义基础更扎实的理解。

Abstract: Earth Observation (EO) has fundamentally transformed the monitoring of environmental processes and human activities up to planetary scale. Recent advances in self-supervised learning have given rise to Earth Observation Foundation Models (EOFMs), which leverage petabyte-scale unlabeled EO data to learn transferable representations across a wide range of downstream geospatial tasks. Despite these advances, current EOFMs remain largely confined to raster modalities, overlooking the rich, structured information encoded in openly-accessible vector data sources such as OpenStreetMap and Overture. Vector data provides explicit and compact representations of geographic entities, including geometry, topology, and semantic relationships, offering critical contextual signals that are often ambiguous or inaccessible in imagery alone. Raster and vector data thus represent complementary views of geographic space: raster data captures continuous physical and spectral patterns, while vector data encodes discrete objects and their relational structure and often represents more of the human rather than the physical systems (e.g. social or demographic data). However, existing geospatial representation learning paradigms treat these modalities in isolation, relying on imperfect and often lossy transformations to bridge them. This perspective paper calls for a paradigm shift toward joint Spatial Representation Learning (SRL) in an unified embedding space that integrate raster perception with vector-based reasoning. Building on emerging efforts in multimodal geospatial learning, we highlight conceptual foundations, technical challenges, and promising directions for aligning heterogeneous spatial data sources. We contend that such integration is essential for developing next-generation geospatial AI systems capable of more accurate, interpretable, and semantically grounded understanding of the Earth.

</details>


### [475] [A Mathematical Conflict Framework for Contextual Data Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02381)
*Hakan Emre Kartal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于广义算子的数学冲突框架，将冲突视为局部、方向性和上下文敏感的独立数学对象，而非优化过程中的隐式副作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常将冲突仅作为嵌入在优化过程中的隐式副作用处理，缺乏对冲突的显式表达和独立建模。

Method: 构建了一个基于广义算子的数学冲突框架，包含加权、尺度行为和输出映射等组件，在统一抽象算子下整合，将冲突定义为局部、方向性和上下文敏感的量。

Result: 该框架是一个通用结构，可适应不同类别的问题，而非特定的学习算法或优化方法。

Conclusion: 冲突应被视为独立的、基于算子的、组件级别的数学对象，而非优化过程中的隐式副产品。

Abstract: In this study, a generalized operator-based mathematical conflict framework is presented to explicitly represent structural discrepancies between raw data and contextual data. The proposed structure treats conflict as a local, directional, and context-sensitive quantity, integrating components such as weighting, scale behavior, and output mapping under a unified abstract operator. Without being reduced to a specific learning algorithm or optimization method, the framework is defined as a general structure adaptable to different classes of problems. While existing approaches typically treat conflict merely as an implicit side effect embedded within the optimization process, the proposed framework considers conflict as an independent, operator-based, and component-level mathematical object.

</details>


### [476] [AgentPLM: Agentic Protein Language Models with Reasoning-Augmented Decoding for Protein Sequence Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02386)
*Sahil Rahman,Maxx Richard Rahman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AgentPLM，将预训练蛋白质语言模型与推理增强解码（RAD）和对比智能体策略优化（CAPO）相结合，使其能够在生成过程中调用外部生物物理工具（如ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina）进行在线校正，在多种蛋白质设计任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型（PLM）是被动神谕，仅通过单次前向传播生成序列，无法在违反热力学或结构约束时咨询外部生物物理反馈并调整生成方向。

Method: 1) 推理增强解码（RAD）：在自回归生成过程中交替调用外部工具（ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina）获取反馈；2) 对比智能体策略优化（CAPO）：基于轨迹级别的直接偏好优化，端到端训练策略，使其学会判断何时利用神谕反馈，而非简单模仿高适应度序列。

Result: 在从头酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性、PPI界面设计和零样本适应度预测等基准任务上达到SOTA，抗体top-10%命中率相比最强被动基线有提升，并提供了在线纠错的机制证据（无需显式回溯）。

Conclusion: AgentPLM通过将PLM与外部生物物理工具集成并进行策略优化，有效弥补了被动生成缺乏反馈机制的局限，在蛋白质设计中取得了显著性能提升。

Abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are passive oracles: they generate sequences in a single forward pass with no mechanism to consult external biophysical feedback or redirect generation when a candidate violates thermodynamic or structural constraints.
